title: Recruitment and Sales Manager - Australian hours
description:
3 months to start at 40 hours per week, with genuine room to continue on and even be promoted | Contractor | Work from home | Immediate start

Real Deal Entertainment (Australia)



IMPORTANT: Applications will only be considered if they include a CV, a video introduction, and written responses to the questions set out below.



THE HONEST SHAPE OF THIS JOB



Two things sit in this seat from day one, and the balance between them shifts as the season moves. We would rather set that out now than have you discover it in week three.



The urgent job is recruiting Christmas Entertainers! For roughly the next month you would be advertising, screening and interviewing performers - Santas, Mrs Clauses, elves, facepainters and photographers - and getting them checked, signed and ready for the season.



After that the hiring eases, but the performer side does not stop. Onboarding, scheduling, logistics, and being the person a performer rings when something goes wrong on the morning of a job.



Alongside all of that, every day, you would be working the sales side: following up the quotes we have already sent and turning them into bookings. From January, when the performer work quietens down, sales becomes the bulk of the role.



ABOUT US



Real Deal Entertainment runs three brands in Australia: The Real Santa, Halloween Scenes and Happy Easter Bunny. We supply professional performers - Santa, Mrs Claus, elves, the Easter Bunny - and large event props, thrones, grottos and sets, to corporate clients, shopping centres, councils, hospitality venues, schools and childcare centres.



It is a premium product at a premium price, and it is seasonal. September to December is our peak, and that is when you would start.



HOW THE WORK ACTUALLY SITS



Month one, mostly recruiting. Writing and placing the advertisements, screening applicants, interviewing, and the Working with Children compliance that goes with putting people in front of children. This is the urgent part, and it is why we are hiring straight away.



We will say plainly that this part is good fun. You would spend a fair bit of your day talking to actors, entertainers and genuinely white-bearded gentlemen, and d
 which of them is good enough to be somebody's Santa. The people who do well at it are the people who enjoy it.



Through the season, running the roster. Onboarding the people you hired, scheduling them against bookings, sorting out the logistics, and keeping them supported. Performers need moral support as much as they need instructions, and the ones who feel looked after are the ones who turn up and do a good job.



Every day, the sales tasks. Time on the open quote bank: ringing clients who already have a quote from us and turning it into a booking. This part does not wait until January.



January onward, mostly sales. Recruiting drops to almost nothing until Easter, so your hours move across: warm calls to past clients who have not rebooked, then reaching out to new ones.



The roster you build is not thrown away. The same performers work our Halloween and Easter seasons, so you would be building something that carries across the year.



THE HOURS



40 hours per week, worked from home. Monday to Friday, 9:00am to 6:00pm Melbourne time, with a one-hour break. If you are applying from the Philippines, that is 6:00am to 3:00pm your time, or 7:00am to 4:00pm once Daylight Saving finishes - the same window the rest of our team works. An early start, but an early finish.



The window is fixed rather than left to you, and it is worth saying why. Client calls only work when Australian clients pick up the phone, and our own call records say that is the afternoon, Melbourne time. The performer side of the job fills the earlier part of the day.



PAY



US$1,330 per month (paid as AU$440 per week), invoiced by you as an independent contractor.



Christmas Day and New Year's Day are not worked, and your fee for those weeks is unchanged.



If the role continues past the first three months, the sales side of it carries commission on top of the weekly fee, on the business you bring in. We would rather agree those rates with you when we know what the role has become than put a number in an advertisement and change it later.



BEFORE YOU APPLY



Note this is a full time role and it will require your complete commitment for the three months. So if you have a side hustle, a part time job, or a house full of kids, we really don't think this will work. We want to put that out there now so there is no disappointment later.



You will need to learn and study fast, meet pressing deadlines, and solve problems daily.



WHAT YOU WOULD ACTUALLY DO



Performers:

- Write and place the advertisements that bring performers in, and keep running the ones that work.

- Screen applicants properly - read the applications, watch the videos, and shortlist on evidence.

- Run the initial interviews - often just a quick phone call - and put a shortlist in front of the Managing Director with your recommendation on each person. You are the first person a performer meets, so how you handle them matters.

- Look after the compliance side: Working with Children Checks and the state-by-state requirements that go with them.

- Onboard the people you hire - paperwork, costumes, briefing, and making sure they know exactly what is expected of them on the day.

- Book the final interviews in, and schedule performers against bookings once they are cast - with all the logistics that go with it.

- Be the person they ring when something goes wrong on the morning of a job, and keep good people feeling looked after.

- Keep the performer records accurate - availability, documents, contact details, and your notes on how people went.



Sales:

- Work the open quote bank to a clear outcome - booked, lost, or closed with a reason.

- Have a proper conversation on every live quote rather than a quick check-in. Find out what the client is actually trying to do with their event.

- Offer the upgrade where it genuinely fits, and leave it alone where it does not.

- Warm calls to clients who have not rebooked, and outreach to new ones, from lists we supply and leads you find.

- Write a dated note in our CRM after every conversation: what the client wants, what you offered, and the next step.



Throughout:

- Short, clear written updates to the Managing Director. Not long reports.

- Use AI to do all of this faster and better, and tell us how you are doing it.



WHAT SITS WITH SOMEONE ELSE



- Raising quotes and invoices. Our customer service team does that; you request and check.

- New inbound sales enquiries. They go to our customer service team.

- The final interview, and the decision on who gets the part. That sits with the Managing Director.



You will still take inbound calls - from performers, and from clients ringing you back after you have called them.



WHERE THIS CAN GO



We cannot promise a permanent role on day one, and we would rather not pretend otherwise.



What we can tell you is that the work does not stop. Easter recruiting begins in the new year, then Winter Christmas, then Halloween, and the sales side runs all year round. We would far rather grow the person already doing it than advertise again.



At the end of the three months we will sit down and talk openly about continuing, about what the role becomes, and about what it pays. If the answer is no, we will tell you why.



WHO WE ARE HOPING TO HEAR FROM



- Someone who has genuinely done both - hired people and sold to people - and can point to each. If your experience sits almost entirely on one side, this is probably not the right fit, though do tell us if you think we have that wrong.

- Someone who would enjoy the performer side rather than tolerate it. Half this job is making good people want to work for you.

- Someone with excellent spoken and written English. You would be interviewing performers and talking to Australian clients.

- Someone confident enough to make a judgement about a person and explain it.

- Someone who uses AI daily and can talk about it in detail - which tools, for what, and what it has actually saved them.

- Someone careful with records and deadlines, who would rather check than assume.

- Performance or event operations experience is a bonus, not a requirement.



WHAT YOU WOULD NEED



- A quiet, professional space for interviews and client calls, a good headset, and reliable internet and power with a backup plan.

- Confident, clear spoken English that an Australian client follows easily. This is the first thing we listen for.

- To invoice us as an independent contractor and look after your own tax and statutory contributions.



HOW TO APPLY



Three parts, about twenty minutes. We read every application that includes all three, and we do not read the ones that do not.



1. Your CV.



2. A video introduction, about two minutes, answering both of the questions below in a single unedited take. Please do not script it - we would rather hear you think than hear you read.



   a. A performer you recruited has cancelled on the morning of a client's event. Talk us through your first ten minutes.



   b. A client has a quote for $1,200 and says that is more than they budgeted. Talk us through how you would respond, as if you were on the call.



3. In writing, no more than 300 words: tell us about one person you hired who worked out well, and one sale you nearly lost and then won. What did you do in each? Finish with one line on which AI tool you use most, and what for.



If you are shortlisted, we will do a short exercise together: we give you our full price list to read for twenty minutes, then ask you ten questions on it with the document closed, and finish with a mock follow-up call. It is all done live in the one session - there is nothing to take away and complete.

title: Life Insurance Administrative Virtual Assistant
description:
** PLEASE READ LIFE INSURANCE EXPERIENCE REQUIRED **



**Company:** Beacon Global Operations

**Position:** Life Insurance Administrative Virtual Assistant

**Work Type:** Remote



## About Beacon



Beacon Global Operations provides specialized back-office administrative support to life insurance brokers and agencies across the United States.



Our Administrative VAs help brokers manage the work that happens **after a life insurance application is submitted**, including pending requirements, carrier follow-up, policy delivery, client documentation, and book-of-business administration.



## REQUIRED: LIFE INSURANCE EXPERIENCE



**Previous life insurance experience is required for this position.**



We are specifically looking for candidates who have worked with **U.S.-based life insurance agents, brokers, agencies, IMOs/FMOs, or life insurance carriers** and understand the life insurance application and underwriting process.



You should already be familiar with concepts such as:



* Pending requirements

* Carrier portals

* Application status

* Underwriting requirements

* Policy issue and placement

* Policy packets

* Beneficiary and ownership information

* Bank drafts and payment information

* Client documentation

* Policy conservation and lapse prevention



**Experience in other industries does not substitute for life insurance experience.**



General VA, real estate, healthcare, customer service, appointment setting, or administrative experience alone will **not** qualify you for this position.



## Responsibilities



Your primary responsibility will be helping life insurance brokers manage their post-sale administrative workload.



Typical tasks include:



* Checking carrier portals for application and policy updates

* Reviewing and completing **pending requirements**

* Following up with clients for missing documents, signatures, banking information, identification, or other requirements

* Following up with carriers regarding outstanding cases

* Tracking applications from submission through issue and placement

* Sending and following up on **policy packets**

* Confirming clients have received required policy documents

* Assisting with policy delivery requirements

* Monitoring policies that may be at risk of lapsing or cancelling

* Assisting with policy conservation and administrative follow-up

* Updating case notes and client records

* Maintaining accurate task and policy statuses

* Suppressing leads after applications or sales when required

* Updating CRM records and client information

* Organizing documents and maintaining accurate case files

* Communicating clearly with brokers regarding outstanding requirements and case updates

* Completing other life-insurance-related back-office administrative tasks



## What We Expect



We are looking for someone who understands that outstanding requirements can directly impact whether a life insurance policy gets issued and placed.



You must be:



* Highly organized

* Detail-oriented

* Comfortable managing multiple insurance cases at once

* Proactive about following up on outstanding requirements

* Able to identify cases that require urgent attention

* Comfortable navigating multiple carrier websites and portals

* Able to communicate professionally with clients, brokers, and carriers

* Consistent with documenting your work

* Comfortable following established SOPs and workflows

* Responsible when handling confidential client information



You should not need to be taught the basics of how a life insurance application moves through underwriting.



## Qualifications



**Required:**



* Previous professional experience in the **U.S. life insurance industry**

* Experience working with life insurance applications and pending requirements

* Experience using life insurance carrier portals

* Understanding of the application → underwriting → issue → placement process

* Strong written and spoken English

* Strong attention to detail

* Reliable computer and internet connection

* Ability to follow standardized procedures and maintain accurate records



Experience with tools such as **GoHighLevel (GHL), CRMs, electronic signature platforms, password managers, and task-management systems** is helpful, but life insurance experience is the primary requirement.



## Important



This is **not a cold-calling or insurance sales position**.



Beacon Administrative VAs focus primarily on **post-sale operations and administrative support** so that licensed brokers can focus on selling and advising their clients.



### To Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. How many years of life insurance experience you have.

2. What company, agency, IMO/FMO, or insurance organization you worked with.

3. Your specific responsibilities in that role.

4. Which life insurance carriers you have experience working with.

5. Your experience handling **pending requirements**.

6. Which carrier portals, CRMs, and insurance systems you have used.



**Applications without previous life insurance experience will not be considered.**

At the same time, you will be working with a company that values community & family in both our internal and customer facing sides. Our mission is to delight kids & parents with creative craft kits and related products. We are 100% focused on that mission and want you to be there on the ride with us!



That’s where you come in as our next Amazon SEO Manager



Role Purpose

The Amazon SEO Manager owns the organic discoverability and conversion performance of our Amazon catalog by building and executing a disciplined SEO system. This role ensures our listings are consistently optimized with the right keywords, content, and structure, so we rank higher, earn more organic traffic, and convert more shoppers - reducing reliance on paid ads over time.



This person translates keyword research, search query data, and competitor insights into prioritized listing actions (titles, bullets, backend terms, images, A+ content), and ensures SEO work is delivered on a reliable cadence aligned with seasonality, pricing strategy, and key retail events.



What Success Looks Like

A successful Amazon SEO Manager consistently increases organic visibility and conversion by keeping keyword strategy, listings, and metadata current and intentional. This person owns the SEO engine that compounds: better indexing, better rankings, higher CTR, higher CVR, and a stronger organic share of sales—without sacrificing brand quality or compliance.



They run a disciplined cadence of keyword research and refresh, systematically improve listings (titles/bullets/A+/images/backend), and translate data (DR/DD/SQP/SI) into prioritized action. They partner closely with PPC and creative to ensure keyword targets, positioning, and content work together—especially during seasonality, deal events, and pricing shifts.



ONE THING: Drive organic ranking, discoverability, and conversion through consistent keyword research, listing optimization, and SEO execution.



Primary Objectives

Keyword Research & Keyword Refresh System

Listing Optimization That Moves CTR + CVR

SEO + Pricing + Event Alignment

Competitive Advantage



Regular Work Activities

Organize and refresh keyword sets (roots + long-tails)

Identify indexing/ranking opportunities; improve keyword organization and tracking

Update keyword clusters for PPC alignment and indexing strategy

Maintain MKL setup/expansion and competitor set updates

Update Data Rova + Data Dive projects (add ASINs, add keywords, track)

General Listing Optimization (Images, Title, Bullets, A+ Content)

Daily spot checks on priority ASINs

Weekly analysis and seasonal updates

Maintain seasonal/event folders + flat files for themed updates

Update keyword focus on listings based on performance and ranking goals

Price Strategy Support (PED, BD, STP, BTP)

Weekly/as-needed price strategy collaboration

STP action reviews after reports; implement improvements tied to velocity + CVR

Ensure consistent lowest 30D price logic where required

Support deal site strategy when applicable (drive off-Amazon traffic into deals)

SQP/SI review weekly/as needed; identify actions and implement

Competitor analysis weekly/as needed (price/listing/keywords/PPC targets)

Manage Experiments monthly/as needed (title/image/A+ testing)

Product classification review monthly (category alignment, item type)

FAQ seeding weekly/as needed

Target: 30+ FAQs added per month (based on ASIN priority list)

Special projects as assigned by leadership (catalog cleanups, large refreshes, launches)

Emergency fixes (suppressed listings, indexing drops, attribute issues)

Weekly SEO/Optimization sync (priority list + actions + blockers)

Weekly PPC alignment (keyword harvesting + targeting coordination)

Weekly creative coordination (assets needed, deadlines, tests)



Key Skills

Amazon SEO strategy + execution (keyword research, indexing, rank growth)

Strong copy + conversion thinking (CTR/CVR-focused content decisions)

Data literacy (SQP/SI/keyword tools) and action orientation

Organized project management across many ASINs

Experimentation mindset (testing, learning, iterating)

Detail-oriented: clean data, labeled projects, tracked changes

Cross-functional collaboration (PPC, creative, ops)



People Contacts and Interactions

PPC Manager: weekly (keyword harvesting + alignment)

Creative: weekly/as needed (images/A+ needs + seasonal themes)

Inventory/Sourcing (China) Team: weekly (priorities + performance actions)

Ops/Leadership: weekly/monthly reporting and priority alignment



Role Requirements

3+ years Amazon SEO / listing optimization experience (high-SKU preferred)

Strong proficiency with keyword tools (Data Dive, SellerSprite, Data Rova or equivalent)

Experience with Amazon reporting and insight tools (SQP/Scale Insights or equivalents)

Proven ability to increase rankings and improve CTR/CVR through listing work

Strong spreadsheet skills and operational discipline

High ownership: “owns the result,” doesn’t give the job back

title: Sales Representative
description:
Join a fast-growing US online home goods retailer and enjoy the learning and opportunities that you have while working with us.



We strive to provide 5-star service & shopping assistance to all of our clients, and all of our team is accountable for fulfilling this.



We are looking for a Sales Representative who can assist prospective buyers and close online ecommerce sales.



We're only looking for full-time, long-term, ongoing cooperation.



Work schedules available:

8 AM to 4 PM EST (8 PM to 4 AM MNL)

4 PM to 12 AM EST (4 AM to 12 PM MNL)



Your work week will be 5 days per week, with 2 days off per week. Days off will be selected with your manager. We will try to accommodate your preferences for which days you like, based on availability.



This role starts ASAP.



Job Duties and Responsibilities:

Receive incoming phone calls and live chats from potential customers (prospects) who indicated that they need shopping assistance. This does not include calls and chats from existing customers that need help with their orders (that’s a job for a different department)

Makes follow-up calls, writes follow-up
s, and text messages to potential buyers. We try to follow up 5x with each person that contacted us (unless they indicate that they are no longer interested). We don’t do cold calling. Only reaching out to prospects who interacted with our online store and left their contact information.

After each interaction with a prospect/customer, writes notes & comments in our CRM (Asana)

Communicate efficiently and build rapport with potential customers

Assists prospects in their shopping journey and helps make the purchase decision

Ensures that all prospects’ questions and objections are addressed

Leads every interaction to a close sale, which means an order is placed on our online store

Prepares custom quotes, price matches competitors if necessary, and offers custom discounts. This requires calculating margins & ensuring profitability.

Answering questions about the products we offer, including technical questions. Learns the specifications, features and benefits of our bestsellers. Over time, becomes an expert in the industry.

If not able to answer product-specific questions, conducts research in the materials provided by the supplier, or reaches out to the supplier to get the information

Confirms stock availability and lead times when offering products to prospects

Documents standard procedures and best practices in a written form, so that other tea ---------- mbers can learn from them



Requirements:

At least 2 years of experience in sales on the phone

Experience must include both inbound and outbound sales

Excellent written and verbal English communication skills

Experience in Customer Service on the phone is a nice to have

Experience in the e-commerce (online shopping) industry is nice to have

Home improvement, construction, and gas plumbing industry experience is a plus

Outgoing, friendly, and lively

Can-do mindset, with a sense of ownership, pride in your performance, and its impact on the company’s success

Long-term commitment - treat this as your career



What we can offer:

Sales commission: 8% of gross profit from all orders closed. Gross profit means the sale amount minus the product and shipping costs. Paid monthly. No upper limit. Monthly commission payouts range between $1,200 (the guaranteed minimum) and as high as $3,000 (for the top performer). The average monthly payout is $1,465 (average from the last 2 years).

$1,200/month minimum guaranteed pay

15 days paid days off per year (also convertible to min. guaranteed commission)

Paid training on all aspects of the role

Opportunities for professional development

Friendly atmosphere

Online Interview process

Fully remote position

title: Tax Accountant
description:
Tax Accountant – Private Family Office Wealth

Newark Advisory Consultants, LLC

Position Type: Part-Time (Potential for Full-Time Conversion)

Industry: Private Family Office / Wealth & Asset Management

Location: 100% Remote – Philippines

Compensation: $9.00 USD per Hour + 10% Performance-Based Monthly Bonus



Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced, detail-oriented, and client-focused Part-Time Tax Accountant to support multiple private family offices serving high-net-worth (HNW) and ultra-high-net-worth (UHNW) individuals and families.

The ideal candidate will have experience in individual, trust, estate, partnership, and investment-related taxation, along with exceptional client-facing communication skills. This role involves direct client interaction, tax preparation and compliance, and coordination with external tax advisors and family office professionals.

This position offers the potential for full-time conversion based on individual performance, organizational needs, and position availability.



Primary Responsibilities

• Serve as a primary point of contact for clients, proactively requesting tax documentation (PBC lists), communicating via phone and
, and following up on outstanding items to ensure timely tax compliance and exceptional client service.

• Prepare and review federal and state tax returns for HNW individuals, trusts, estates, partnerships, LLCs, corporations, and other family-owned entities.

• Prepare quarterly estimated tax calculations, annual tax projections, and related payment schedules.

• Review financial statements, general ledgers, investment statements, Schedules K-1, Forms 1099, and other supporting tax documentation.

• Support tax planning related to investment income, capital gains, trusts, estates, wealth transfers, and family-owned entities.

• Research federal and state tax regulations and assist with tax notices, audits, and multistate reporting requirements.

• Coordinate with external CPAs, tax attorneys, wealth advisors, and family office accounting teams to facilitate tax preparation and compliance.

• Maintain organized tax records, track filing deadlines, and manage outstanding client requests and deliverables.

• Assist with tax-related reconciliations, year-end adjustments, and special projects as assigned.



Qualifications

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

• Minimum of 2 years of tax preparation, compliance, or accounting experience, preferably serving HNW individuals, trusts, partnerships, or privately held entities.

• Strong knowledge of U.S. federal and state individual, partnership, and fiduciary taxation, including Forms 1040, 1041, 1065, and 709. 

• Exceptional client-facing communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to professionally engage HNW clients, clearly communicate documentation requirements, and proactively manage follow-ups.

• Familiarity with investment-related tax reporting, including capital gains, investment income, and Schedules K-1; Form 1065.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including formulas, data analysis, and reconciliations, and other tax preparation software.

• Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to independently manage multiple priorities and deadlines.

• High level of professionalism, discretion, and confidentiality when handling sensitive client financial information.



Preferred Qualifications

• Four (4) or more years of tax preparation, compliance, or accounting experience, preferably serving HNW individuals, trusts, partnerships, or privately held entities.

• Certified Public Accountant (CPA). 

• Experience in a single-family office, multi-family office, private wealth management firm, or public accounting practice serving HNW/UHNW clients.

• Knowledge of estate and gift taxation, family investment partnerships, trusts, real estate, and alternative investments.

• Experience with CCH Axcess, ProSystem fx, UltraTax, or similar tax software.



Work Arrangement & Full-Time Conversion Opportunity

This is a 100% remote, part-time position based in the Philippines. Candidates must be available for scheduled meetings and client communications during designated U.S. business hours. Additional flexibility may be required during peak tax seasons and filing deadlines.

High-performing candidates who demonstrate strong technical expertise, exceptional client service, and consistent reliability will be considered for full-time conversion, subject to business needs and position availability.



Compensation

• Range Base Pay: $7.00 - $9.00 USD per hour depending on experience. 

• Performance-Based Monthly Bonus: Eligible for a monthly bonus of up to 10% of base earnings, based on demonstrated performance, quality and accuracy of work, timely completion of assignments, client service, and achievement of established performance expectations. Bonus payments are subject to management review and discretionary approval.



About the Opportunity

This role provides the opportunity to support multiple high-net-worth families in a specialized private wealth environment, with exposure to investment structures, trusts, partnerships, and family-owned entities.

We are seeking a dependable tax professional who combines technical expertise with exceptional client service, professionalism, and discretion and is interested in a potential long-term opportunity with the firm.



About Newark Advisory Consultants LLC

Newark Advisory Consultants LLC is a private boutique family-owned financial services firm dedicated to serving high-net-worth (HNW) and ultra-high-net-worth (UHNW) individuals, families, and privately held businesses. We specialize in providing personalized financial management, accounting, tax coordination, and family office support services tailored to the unique needs of our clients. With a focus on professionalism, discretion, and long-term relationships, our firm works closely with clients and their trusted advisors to help navigate complex financial matters, preserve generational wealth, and support their evolving financial goals. We pride ourselves on delivering attentive, high-quality service built on integrity, confidentiality, and a commitment to excellence through our professionals. 



Please forward to us in a message a copy of your current resume for consideration. Also include one sentence why you should be considered for this role. Should your qualifications meet our needs for an interview, a member of our team will contact you directly. Thank you for your interest.

title: Personal Executive Assistant / Lifestyle Manager
description:
# Personal Executive Assistant / Lifestyle Manager (Remote – Philippines)



**Salary:** ₱40,000–45,000 PHP/month (approximately C$900–1,000)  

**Employment:** Full-time, 40 hours per week  

**Location:** Remote – Philippines  

**Schedule:** Flexible, with some overlap during Canadian Eastern Time business hours  

**Position:** Long-term, with opportunities for growth



## About the Role



I'm a young entrepreneur based in Canada looking for an exceptional Personal Executive Assistant to help manage my day-to-day life, personal responsibilities, research, travel, household coordination, and occasional business projects.



I'm looking for someone intelligent, resourceful, organized, trustworthy, and highly proactive.



This is not a typical virtual assistant position where you simply wait for instructions. I want someone who can take ownership of tasks, independently solve problems, anticipate needs, and follow through until things are completed.



Think of this position as a combination of a personal assistant, lifestyle manager, researcher, and problem solver.



My goal is to find someone who can take a wide variety of tasks off my plate so I can focus on my business and other priorities.



## Key Responsibilities



### 1. Personal & Lifestyle Management

- Manage my calendar, appointments, reminders, and important deadlines.

- Track upcoming bills, renewals, subscriptions, and personal responsibilities.

- Research and arrange restaurant reservations, activities, appointments, and experiences.

- Help plan birthdays, special occasions, events, and personal activities.

- Research purchases, compare products, find deals, and organize returns.

- Learn my preferences and proactively suggest ways to make my life easier.



### 2. Meal Planning & Grocery Management

- Create weekly meal plans with healthy, high-protein recipes based on my preferences and fitness goals.

- Research interesting recipes, cooking methods, and meal ideas.

- Prepare organized grocery lists with ingredients, quantities, and estimated prices.

- Compare grocery prices across Canadian retailers such as Costco, Walmart, and other local stores.

- Prepare online grocery carts for delivery or pickup.

- Research healthier alternatives and convenient meal preparation options.

- Maintain a list of favourite recipes, meals, and regularly purchased groceries.



### 3. Travel Planning & Booking

- Research flights, train tickets, hotels, Airbnbs, and other accommodations.

- Find the best value by comparing prices, routes, travel times, baggage fees, and cancellation policies.

- Create organized travel itineraries with booking links and recommendations.

- Research restaurants, attractions, activities, and experiences at travel destinations.

- Track travel reservations and important upcoming dates.

- Assist with booking arrangements once approved.



### 4. Household Management & Vendor Coordination

- Contact companies regarding orders, delayed deliveries, refunds, warranties, and customer service issues.

- Coordinate household services, cleaners, maintenance, repairs, and contractors.

- Follow up with businesses until outstanding issues are resolved.

- Research interior designers, furniture, home improvements, and household products.

- Track deliveries, appointments, and ongoing household projects.

- Compare service providers, request quotes, and present recommendations.



### 5. Communication,
s & Occasional Phone Calls

- Send professional
s on my behalf to businesses, retailers, service providers, and other contacts.

- Occasionally make phone calls to Canadian or American companies to resolve issues, confirm reservations, request information, or follow up on orders.

- Handle customer service inquiries through
, live chat, and phone when necessary.

- Communicate professionally with restaurants, hotels, airlines, contractors, and other businesses.

- Keep clear records of communications and follow up when necessary.

- Provide updates on outcomes, next steps, and any decisions requiring my approval.



**Excellent spoken and written English is essential.** You must feel confident communicating with North American businesses.



This is primarily a personal assistance, research, and organization position — not a call centre job. Phone calls will only be required occasionally.



### 6. General Research & AI

- Research a broad range of topics, including products, services, technology, travel, business opportunities, home improvement, and everyday questions.

- Use ChatGPT and other AI tools to improve research quality and efficiency.

- Independently verify important information rather than simply copying AI-generated answers.

- Compare products, prices, reviews, quality, and alternatives.

- Research unfamiliar topics and develop practical solutions.

- Present findings in a concise, organized format with sources, links, prices, pros and cons, and recommendations.

- Be comfortable receiving new or unusual tasks and figuring out how to complete them independently.



### 7. Business & Administrative Support

- Assist with occasional business research and administrative projects.

- Organize spreadsheets, documents, files, and information.

- Track project deadlines and outstanding tasks.

- Coordinate with team members when requested.

- Help improve organization and productivity through useful systems and tools.



## What I'm Looking For



**Required Qualifications**

- Excellent spoken and written English.

- At least 2 years of executive assistant, personal assistant, or similar experience preferred.

- Strong independent research and problem-solving skills.

- Highly organized with excellent attention to detail.

- Proactive and comfortable taking initiative.

- Confident communicating with Canadian and American businesses through
, live chat, and occasional phone calls.

- Comfortable using ChatGPT, Google Workspace, spreadsheets, and online research tools.

- Trustworthy, discreet, reliable, and professional.

- Able to manage multiple tasks and provide clear updates.

- Willing to learn new software, tools, and processes.



**Ideal Personality**



I'm looking for someone who is naturally curious, resourceful, organized, and enjoys solving problems.



You should be the type of person who sees a problem, researches possible solutions, takes appropriate action, and follows through without needing constant reminders.



I value initiative, good judgment, honesty, attention to detail, and clear communication.



## Examples of Tasks You Might Receive



- "My internet provider hasn't delivered my TV receiver. Can you contact them and find out what's happening?"

- "My furniture order is delayed. Can you follow up with the store and find a solution?"

- "Find the best-value flights to Europe next month."

- "Research affordable train tickets for an upcoming trip."

- "Find a great restaurant for Friday night and check reservation availability."

- "Put together five healthy, high-protein dinners and prepare a grocery shopping list."

- "Interior designer with these dimensions of a room and find products for good deals."

- "Compare three products and tell me which one is the best value."

- "Research a topic I'm interested in and give me a clear, useful summary."



You would independently research the issue, communicate with relevant people when authorized, provide recommendations, and follow up until the task is completed.



## Communication & Daily Workflow



We will primarily communicate through WhatsApp or a similar messaging platform.



I may send messages, questions, or voice notes throughout the day.



You will be expected to:

- Organize and prioritize incoming tasks.

- Maintain a clear task tracker.

- Provide concise daily updates on completed tasks, outstanding issues, and upcoming deadlines.

- Follow up on unresolved matters without being reminded.

- Ask questions when necessary and use good judgment when working independently.

- Obtain approval before making purchases, committing to expenses, or making important account changes.



You will receive appropriate access to the tools and information needed for your work. Confidentiality, privacy, and responsible handling of information are essential.



## Compensation & Growth



**Starting Salary: ₱40,000–45,000 PHP per month**, depending on experience and qualifications.



What I Offer:

- Stable, long-term employment.

- Paid onboarding and training.

- Flexible working arrangements.

- Performance and salary review after 90 days.

- Opportunities for increased compensation as responsibilities grow.

- Potential to develop into a senior executive assistant or personal operations manager.



I'm looking to build a long-term working relationship with someone who wants to grow in this position.



## How to Apply



Please include the following:



1. Your resume and relevant work experience.

2. A short introduction explaining why you would be a great fit.

3. A 1–2 minute English voice recording introducing yourself and discussing your experience.

4. An example of a difficult problem you independently solved for a previous employer.

5. The AI tools and productivity software you regularly use.

6. Your expected monthly salary in PHP.

7. Your availability to work some overlapping Canadian Eastern Time hours.



**Important:** Please begin your application with the words **"PROACTIVE ASSISTANT"** so I know you have read the entire job description.



I'm looking for someone exceptional who wants a stable, long-term opportunity and genuinely enjoys helping people, solving problems, and making things run smoothly.

title: Freelance Kitchen & Bath Designer
description:
Freelance Kitchen & Bath Designer — Houzz Pro, Cabinet Renderings & Tile Elevations



Company: Miss K Kitchen & Bath Remodels

Location: Remote — Philippines

Engagement: Freelance, with opportunities for ongoing project assignments

Compensation: Target budget of USD $6–$10/hour, depending on demonstrated skills and experience. Please submit your requested rate. Fixed project pricing may also be considered.

Hours: Assigned according to project needs; no guaranteed weekly hours

Schedule: Flexible working hours, with agreed deadlines and occasional scheduled meetings with our Utah-based team



About Us



Miss K Kitchen & Bath Remodels is a residential remodeling company serving Salt Lake City and Utah County, Utah.



We create thoughtfully designed kitchens and bathrooms with beautiful materials, functional layouts, and careful attention to detail. We value good listening, clear communication, and accurate work that helps our clients feel confident in their decisions.



We are seeking a skilled designer in the Philippines to build an ongoing working relationship with our team.



Project Volume & Opportunity



We typically work on two remodeling projects per month, with as many as four projects in busier months, primarily kitchens and bathrooms.



Design needs vary by project. Assignments may include updated layouts, cabinet renderings, tile elevations, or a complete design package.



This opportunity is suitable for a freelancer who can accommodate recurring assignments alongside other commitments. There are no guaranteed weekly hours or minimum project volume. Each assignment will have an agreed scope, deadline, and budget before work begins.



About the Role



You will turn supplied measurements, sketches, photos, walkthrough videos, and design direction into accurate floor plans, cabinet layouts, renderings, and tile elevations.



Your work will help homeowners visualize their remodel and help subcontractors and suppliers prepare clear, consistent bids. Approved drawings will also communicate design intent to our installation team.



Hands-on experience building layouts in Houzz Pro’s 3D Floor Planner is required. Experience using Houzz Pro only for leads, estimates, or administrative tasks does not meet this requirement.



You will work directly inside our existing Houzz Pro projects using your own team-member login.



What We Provide



* Site measurements and sketches.

* Existing-condition photos and walkthrough videos.

* Client requirements and budget direction.

* Design inspiration and selected materials, when available.

* Feedback and final design approval.

* Administrative support for project files and coordination.



You are expected to identify missing information, ask specific questions, and flag conflicts before proceeding.



Responsibilities



Floor Plans & Space Planning



* Create existing-condition and proposed floor plans.

* Develop functional kitchen and bathroom layouts based on client needs, budget, and supplied measurements.

* Provide alternate layouts when requested.

* Show relevant dimensions, door swings, windows, fixtures, appliances, and cabinetry.

* Clearly identify items to remain, be removed, or be relocated.

* Flag layout conflicts and areas requiring field verification.



Cabinet Layouts & Renderings



* Design kitchen cabinet arrangements, bathroom vanities, islands, and storage layouts.

* Account for cabinet dimensions, fillers, end panels, appliance openings, and clearances.

* Prepare cabinet elevations and relevant views.

* Apply proposed cabinet finishes, countertops, hardware, and surrounding materials.

* Produce renderings that accurately reflect the proposed layout.

* Clearly identify products or details represented approximately.



Tile Elevations & Layouts



* Prepare dimensioned tile elevations for shower walls, tub surrounds, bathroom walls, kitchen backsplashes, and other tiled surfaces.

* Create floor tile layouts when required.

* Identify tile manufacturer, collection, size, color, and finish when selected.

* Show tile orientation, installation pattern, starting points, alignment, and intended cuts.

* Specify proposed grout joint size and grout color.

* Detail borders, accent bands, feature panels, and material transitions.

* Locate niches, benches, curbs, windows, and fixtures using supplied dimensions.

* Identify exposed edges, edge trim, and corner treatments.

* Prepare tile quantity worksheets showing net tiled areas, proposed waste allowances, and trim quantities separately.



Use Houzz Pro wherever practical. If detailed tile elevations require a supplemental drafting program, save the finished PDFs in the appropriate Houzz Pro project and provide editable source files.



Bid Packages & Project Organization



* Assemble clear drawings and design notes for subcontractor and supplier bidding.

* Keep plans, elevations, renderings, and material schedules consistent.

* Incorporate feedback accurately and maintain the latest approved version.

* Communicate progress and notify us promptly of questions or potential delays.



Required Qualifications



* Demonstrated proficiency in Houzz Pro’s 3D Floor Planner.

* Residential kitchen and bathroom design experience.

* Ability to produce accurate, dimensioned plans and elevations.

* Experience preparing detailed tile elevations.

* Understanding of cabinetry, appliance specifications, door swings, and installation clearances.

* Ability to work accurately in feet and inches.

* Strong written English and clear communication during video meetings.

* Reliable computer and internet connection suitable for browser-based 3D design.

* Strong attention to detail and dependable follow-through.

* Ability to work independently and ask questions when information is incomplete.



Preferred Experience



* Previous work with U.S. remodeling companies, interior designers, or cabinet suppliers.

* Custom cabinetry or millwork experience.

* Decorative tile patterns, borders, niches, and mixed-material designs.

* Houzz Pro selection boards and material organization.

* Familiarity with U.S. residential construction practices.

* AutoCAD or another drafting program for supplemental drawings.



Expected Deliverables



Depending on the assignment, a project package may include:



* Existing-condition floor plan.

* Dimensioned proposed floor plan.

* Cabinet layout and elevations.

* Two to four rendered views.

* Tile elevations and floor tile layout.

* Finish and fixture schedule.

* Tile quantity worksheet.

* Bid notes and outstanding questions.

* Revised final drawings following review.



Accuracy and coordination matter as much as appearance. Your work should help bidders understand the scope and help installers understand the approved design intent.



Turnaround Expectations



Our initial targets, after receiving complete project information, are:



* Initial bathroom layout: 1–2 business days.

* Initial kitchen layout: 2–3 business days.

* Bathroom drawing and rendering package: 3–5 business days.

* Kitchen drawing and rendering package: 5–7 business days.

* Detailed tile elevations: Typically 1–2 additional business days.

* Minor revisions: 1–2 business days.



Complete-package targets assume prompt feedback and one consolidated revision round. Deadlines will be agreed upon based on project complexity, your availability, and the approved scope.



Please explain your typical turnaround in your application. Notify us promptly if missing information or a change in scope affects delivery.



Review & Approval



Miss K approves designs before they are released for client presentation, bidding, or installation.



Final site dimensions, cabinet ordering, construction feasibility, and any required engineering or permit documentation will be verified by the appropriate local team members or professionals. You are responsible for flagging concerns and clearly identifying items requiring verification.



Compensation & Assignment Approval



Please submit your requested hourly rate in USD and any minimum engagement requirements.



For hourly assignments, we will agree on an estimated number of hours and a maximum approved budget before work begins. Additional hours require approval. Fixed project pricing may be agreed upon once the scope is defined.



Shortlisted applicants will complete a clearly scoped, paid skills assessment.



How to Apply



Use “Miss K — Houzz Pro Designer” as your application subject line.



Please include:



1. A brief introduction and your relevant kitchen and bathroom design experience.

2. Your specific experience with Houzz Pro’s 3D Floor Planner.

3. Two projects you personally created in Houzz Pro, showing dimensioned layouts and renderings.

4. At least one detailed tile elevation you personally prepared.

5. A description of your contribution to each portfolio example.

6. Your requested hourly rate in USD and any minimum engagement requirements.

7. Your availability and available meeting times in Utah Mountain Time.

8. Your typical turnaround for kitchen and bathroom assignments.

9. Any supplemental software you use and whether you already have a licensed subscription.



Please also answer:



If the measurements, photos, and design instructions do not agree, how would you handle that before completing the design?



Finalists will be invited to a screen-share demonstration and a paid assessment inside a designated Miss K Houzz Pro project.



We are looking for a dependable designer who enjoys thoughtful design, accurate drawings, and a lasting working relationship with a growing remodeling company.

title: B2B SaaS Sales Executive
description:
Votel Academy is a growing AI software education, training, and agency-support company focused on helping marketing agencies and businesses implement AI-powered automation technology.



We provide educational resources, software tools, implementation guidance, and support for agencies using Votel.ai, an AI-powered business automation platform.



We're building an aggressive, performance-driven sales organization and looking for an experienced B2B SaaS Sales Executive who can help us acquire new customers and grow our recurring revenue.



This is NOT a virtual assistant position, customer service position, or appointment-setting-only role.



We need a true sales hunter who knows how to find qualified prospects, start conversations, conduct software demonstrations, overcome objections, and CLOSE DEALS.



If you require months of training before you can start producing sales, this is not the right opportunity.



If you have a proven track record selling software to US businesses and enjoy being rewarded for your performance, we want to speak with you.



Your Responsibilities



You will own the full sales cycle, including:



Researching and identifying US-based marketing agencies, digital agencies, AI automation agencies, and business consultants.



Building targeted prospect lists and identifying decision-makers.



Conducting personalized outbound prospecting through approved channels.



Starting conversations with qualified business prospects.



Booking and conducting software demonstrations.

Identifying customer needs and presenting appropriate software solutions.



Handling objections and closing paid subscriptions.



Following up consistently with interested prospects.



Managing your sales pipeline using our CRM.



Maintaining accurate records of prospecting activity, demonstrations, and conversions.



Reporting daily activity and weekly sales results.



Collaborating directly with company leadership to improve our sales process.



You will be responsible for generating your own opportunities, not simply waiting for inbound leads.



Performance Expectations



Our minimum ongoing production target is 25 new paid business subscriptions per month.



This is a results-driven position with clear expectations.



First 5 Business Days



Complete platform and sales training.



Understand our target market and ideal customer profile.



Learn our CRM and sales process.



Begin active prospecting.



Build an initial qualified prospect pipeline.



Target is to have first sale in 5 days, if no sale possible separation



Days 6–14



Conduct qualified sales conversations and software demonstrations.



Generate your first paid subscriptions.



Target at least 5 new paid accounts.



Days 15–30



Continue consistent outbound prospecting and demonstrations.



Follow up with active opportunities.



Target 20 additional paid subscriptions.



Month 2 and Beyond



Maintain a minimum target of 25 new paid subscriptions per month.



Develop a consistent and repeatable sales pipeline.



Improve conversion rates and prospect quality.



Maintain accurate CRM records and performance reporting.



We understand that results depend on market conditions, lead quality, and customer decisions. However, we are looking for someone with the experience and initiative to pursue these targets immediately.



Required Qualifications



At least 2 years of proven B2B sales experience.



Demonstrated success selling SaaS, CRM, marketing automation, or similar technology.



Experience selling to US business owners or decision-makers.



Proven ability to generate leads independently.



Strong cold prospecting and outbound sales skills.



Experience conducting live software demonstrations.



Excellent spoken and written English.



Confidence handling objections and asking for the sale.



Experience managing a CRM and sales pipeline.



Strong organizational skills and follow-up discipline.



Reliable internet connection and professional workspace.



Availability during US Eastern business hours.



Highly Preferred Experience



Candidates with experience in any of the following will receive priority consideration:



GoHighLevel



Votel.ai



HubSpot



Salesforce



AI voice agents



Marketing automation software



White-label SaaS platforms



Digital marketing agency sales



AI automation agency services



Full-cycle B2B SaaS sales



We are particularly interested in candidates who have previously sold software subscriptions to marketing agencies.



Compensation



Base Salary: $900 per month



Your exact base salary will depend on your experience, documented sales results, and interview performance.



Recurring Sales Commission: 20%



You will receive 20% of the qualifying affiliate commissions Votel Academy actually collects from each customer you acquire, for that customer's first 12 paid subscription months.



This structure rewards both new customer acquisition and ongoing customer retention.



Commissions are subject to a written compensation agreement and applicable payment, attribution, cancellation, and refund rules.



There are no guaranteed commission earnings.



Additional Benefits



Work remotely from the Philippines.



Work directly with company leadership.



Access to AI software and sales tools.



Ongoing product and sales training.



Opportunity to help build a growing sales organization.



Potential advancement into a senior sales or sales management role.



Performance-based earning potential.



What Makes This Opportunity Different?



We are not hiring someone to simply work through a list of leads.



We are building a sales organization around AI-powered business software, education, and agency-support services.



You will have the opportunity to help establish the sales process, contribute ideas, develop prospecting strategies, and play a meaningful role in the company's growth.



We value initiative, accountability, communication, and measurable results.



How to Apply



To be considered, please submit the following:



1. Resume or LinkedIn Profile



Provide your professional background and relevant sales experience.



2. Sales Experience Summary



Tell us which SaaS or technology products you've sold, the types of customers you've sold to, and your role in the sales process.



3. Actual Sales Results



Provide your average monthly closed deals over the past 6–12 months.



Include conversion rates, quota attainment, or other measurable results where available.



4. Short Video Introduction



Record a 60–90-second video introducing yourself and explaining why you're qualified for this position.



We want to evaluate your communication skills, confidence, and ability to present professionally.



5. Sales Strategy Question



Answer the following:



"If you were responsible for acquiring 25 new paying AI software customers per month from US marketing agencies, how would you approach prospecting, demonstrations, follow-up, and closing?"



Be specific.



6. Compensation Expectations



Confirm your expected monthly base salary and availability to work US Eastern business hours.



IMPORTANT APPLICATION INSTRUCTION



Start your application with the exact words:



ACADEMY SALES



Applications that do not follow the instructions may not be considered.



Final Note



We are looking for a genuine sales professional who can produce results—not someone who simply wants a remote job.



If you're experienced in B2B SaaS sales, comfortable generating your own opportunities, and confident in your ability to close business, we'd like to hear from you.



Apply today and help us build Votel Academy's sales organization

title: Senior Video Editor (Short-Form) for a London Venture Media Company, Full-Time, $1,300 to $1,800/month
description:
Salary:  $1,300 to $1,800 USD per month, depending on experience

Type: Full-time, long-term, remote

Hours: Flexible. We work to deadlines, just make sure you respond within 12 hours and don't miss deadlines

Start: As soon as we find the right person



Who we are



The Path Less Ventured (TPLV) is a London-based media company covering European tech. We film founders, investors and operators at the biggest startup events in Europe, including Sifted Summit, Web Summit and Slush, and in sit-down interviews, then turn that footage into short clips that run daily on LinkedIn and Instagram. Our tagline is "The reality of building, on the record." Our job is to make the people building Europe's companies visible, as real people rather than headlines.



We're small and growing fast. Our anchor sponsor is a major UK bank, we have a full event calendar through 2027, and we're about to launch a retained production arm for venture firms. You can see our work on LinkedIn under The Path Less Ventured.



The role



You'll be our first in-house editor and the person who owns our short-form output. Once you're up to speed, that means around 20 to 30 vertical clips a week cut from interview and event footage, each one captioned, name-carded and finished to our brand guide.



Through 2027 the work expands into long-form interviews and, later, a podcast. As the business grows, we plan to hire more editors, and we'd want you to lead them. If you want to build a team rather than just sit in a timeline, this is that role.



AI tools are part of the daily job here. We use Claude, ChatGPT and Higgsfield for transcript work, cut selection, captions, b-roll and workflow. We're not looking for someone who's heard of them. We want someone who already uses them to work faster and better, and can show us how.



**What you'll do**



- Cut 20 to 30 short vertical clips a week from raw interview and event footage

- Choose the moments. We want an editor with judgement about what makes a clip worth watching, not just someone who trims where they're told

- Add captions, name cards, logos and end cards to our brand guide

- Use AI tools throughout your process and keep improving how we use them

- Work from a shared pipeline with clear briefs and deadlines, mostly asynchronously

- Move into long-form interview edits and podcast production as those launch

- Help us hire and lead more editors as the team grows



**What we provide**



- The top-tier $200/month plans for Claude and ChatGPT, paid by us, plus Higgsfield and any other tool you need to do the job well. If a tool makes you faster, we'll pay for it

- After six months in the role, a new laptop and any other equipment upgrades you need, at our cost

- Paid test task before you join, so you're never working for free

- A clear path to leading the editing team as we grow



You need



- Three or more years editing professionally, with real short-form work you can show

- Strong DaVinci Resolve or Adobe Premiere Pro

- Daily, practical experience with AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT and Higgsfield in an editing workflow

- A good eye for pacing, hooks and what holds attention on a phone screen

- Reliable delivery. We publish daily, so missed deadlines mean gaps in the feed

- Clear written English. Most of our communication is in writing

- For the first six months, a machine that can handle 4K footage comfortably (Apple Silicon or a dedicated GPU, 16GB RAM minimum) and a stable connection of at least 25 Mbps. After that, we upgrade you



**Nice to have**



- Graphic design skills (thumbnails, title cards, social templates)

- Motion graphics in After Effects or Fusion

- Experience with interview, talking-head or podcast content

- Any experience leading or reviewing other editors' work



**How hiring works**



We keep it short and we pay for your time.



1. Apply with your portfolio. We review and reply to everyone who follows the instructions below.

2. Short video call (about 30 minutes) to talk through your work and how you edit.

3. Paid test task. We send you raw footage from a real TPLV interview and you cut three vertical clips with captions and name cards to our brand guide. You're paid for this whether or not you get the role.

4. Decision. If it's a yes, you get an offer. If it's a no, we tell you specifically why, so you leave with something useful.



**How to apply**



Start your application with the word PATH so we know you've read this far.



Then include:



1. Links to three short-form clips you cut yourself, ideally vertical with captions. Tell us briefly what you were responsible for on each

2. Two or three sentences on how you currently use AI tools in your editing

3. Your computer spec and internet speed

4. Your earliest start date



Applications that skip these won't be considered. Everything else about you, we'll find out on the call.

title: Out bound Lead Caller and Social Media Response
description:
Lead Follow-Up and Appointment Setter, US Medical Practice. Base Pay + Big Commission. Work From Home.



**Pay:** $4.00 USD per hour base on shift. Commission pays more than base if you produce. Details below. Paid weekly.



**Type:** Full time, long term, work from home (Philippines).



---



## The job in one paragraph



We are a medical practice in Missouri, USA. About 900 people asked us for treatment in the last 3 months. Most of them were never called back properly, because 6 out of 10 leads arrive at night and on weekends when our office is closed, and by morning they have gone cold or booked somewhere else. Your job is to work those leads: call, text,
, book the first visit, confirm it, and call back every no-show until they rebook. That is the whole job. Do it well and you will out-earn almost any VA job on this site.



## Your day



1. New lead arrives, you contact it fast. During your shift, first attempt inside 15 minutes.

2. You follow up by phone, text, and
 until the person books, says no, or finishes the sequence.

3. You book first visits and write the outcome in the CRM (GoHighLevel) the same day.

4. You confirm tomorrow's appointments so people actually show up.

5. You call every patient who no-showed that day and get them rebooked.

6. End of shift, you send one short report: leads in, contacted, booked, showed, recovered.



## The pay. Simple.



**On shift** (US Central 8 AM to 5 PM, Mon to Fri, which is 9 PM to 6 AM Philippine time):

- $4.00 per hour base.

- PLUS $5 for every new patient you book who shows up, and $5 more when that patient books their plan visit after the first one.



**Off hours** (before 8 AM, after 5 PM, weekends, whenever you choose to log in):

- No hourly pay. You are paid for results only, at premium rates:

- $12 for every new patient you book who shows up.

- $8 more when that patient books their plan visit. $20 total per converted patient.

- $8 for every no-show you recover who shows up.



**Fine print that protects you:** every call, text, and booking is timestamped in the CRM. Commission is counted from the practice's appointment records every Friday and paid with the next week's pay. If a patient shows, you get paid. There is no argument and no chasing.



**What a producer makes:** our leads run about 200 a month. A setter who works them properly shows 15 to 30 new patients a week across shift and off hours. That is $150 to $500 a week in commission, on top of base, paid by a practice that has the patient volume to keep it going.



## Do not apply if



- Your spoken English is not strong and clear. You will talk to American patients all shift.

- You cannot work the night shift hours on a stable schedule.

- You do not update records as you go. In this job, if it is not in the CRM, it did not happen.



## Requirements



- 1+ year of appointment setting, call center, sales support, or customer service. Healthcare is a plus, not required.

- Quiet workspace, good headset, internet 25 Mbps or faster, backup power or internet plan.

- Persistent, organized, and you like being measured. This job has a scoreboard and the scoreboard d
 who stays.



## How to apply (exactly this, or your application is deleted unread)



1. Start your message with the words BLUE SPRINGS.

2. Send a voice recording, 60 seconds max, reading this: "Hi, this is [your name] from Core Medical Center. You asked us about treatment recently, and I am calling to get your first visit on the schedule. We have openings this week in Blue Springs and Overland Park. Which day works best for you?" (Vocaroo or Google Drive link.)

3. Three sentences on your last setting or call center job and your numbers there.

4. Screenshot of your internet speed test and a photo of your workspace.



## Trial



Two week paid trial at base rate. Hit the targets (fast first contact, your bookings showing at 80%+, the no-show list worked every day) and the job is permanent, with commission counted from the trial bookings that show. We are hiring two setters to start, one focused on each location's list. The ones who produce will be kept, paid, and given more responsibility.

title: CSM Admin Support
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



We're hiring a full-time Client Success Admin Support to look after our clients from the day they sign up. You'll work directly with our Customer Success Manager and be the person clients hear from most: onboarding them, answering their questions and making sure nothing slips.



This is a long-term remote role on Singapore hours (same time zone as the Philippines).



About Play Bigger Mentoring

Play Bigger Mentoring is Singapore's fastest growing company running high-ticket coaching programmes, live sales events and software for coaches, financial advisers and business owners across Asia. Our clients invest thousands of dollars to work with us, and how we treat them after they pay d
 whether they stay, refer and renew.



Why This Role Is Different

• You'll support real, high-paying clients (business owners and financial advisers), not an anonymous ticket queue

• Every reply matters. A fast, clear answer keeps a client happy. A slow or careless one can cost us a renewal.

• You'll see the whole client journey, from live events to onboarding, coaching sessions and results



We give you templates, SOPs and a clear escalation path. We also expect you to use judgment, read the situation and know when to pick up the phone instead of typing.

For the right person, this role grows into a Client Success Manager position.



What You'll Do

• Onboard new clients within 24 hours of sign-up: welcome messages, programme access, software logins, calendars and WhatsApp groups

• Reply to client messages on WhatsApp,
 and our helpdesk within our response times, and escalate what you can't solve with full context

• Get on calls with clients for onboarding, check-ins and the occasional frustrated client

• Book and reschedule coaching sessions, send reminders and follow up on missed sessions

• Keep client records and the client tracker accurate in GoHighLevel: onboarding status, attendance, milestones and open issues

• Support registration, check-in and client questions during our live events, and send a weekly summary of client issues and wins

Priorities come from our Customer Success Manager. Payment questions go to our finance team, and you keep the client informed.



What You Will NOT Be Responsible For

• Selling or closing deals. Our sales team handles that.

• Approving refunds, discounts or changes to payment plans

• Delivering coaching or giving business advice to clients

• Chasing overdue payments. Our finance team owns collections.



Your focus is a smooth, well-run client experience.



Who This Role Is For

• You have 2+ years of customer-facing experience in client success, customer support, account management, front desk or executive assistant work

• Your written English is clear, warm and correct, and people understand your replies the first time

• You're confident speaking English on calls, including with senior business owners who are upset

• You're highly organised and close every loop without being reminded

• You're strict about privacy: client personal and payment details stay in approved channels, and you use secure passwords and 2FA

• You can commit full-time to one team, with stable internet, a backup connection and a quiet, private space for calls



Who This Role Is NOT For

• People who send the same copy-paste reply to every client

• Freelancers juggling other clients

• Anyone uncomfortable speaking with clients on calls

• People who need to be reminded to follow up



How We Work

We judge people on results, not hours logged.

• Client-first: fast, clear, honest replies, even when the news isn't good

• Systems-led: SOPs, templates, a CRM and a clear escalation path

• Small team: you'll work directly with our Customer Success Manager and the founders



Compensation & Growth

• SGD 30,000 to 45,000 per month, depending on experience

• SOPs, templates and training on our CRM and helpdesk

• A growth path to Client Success Manager

• Exposure to live events, coaching programmes and client automation



This role suits someone who takes pride in making clients feel looked after. It is not a low-effort, inbox-only job.



How to Apply

Please complete the application form carefully. It includes a short voice or video recording, so set aside about 30 minutes. 



The questions are designed to understand how you communicate and handle clients, not just which tools you've used.



👉 Apply here: 



Applications sent by
 or direct message won't be reviewed. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.



Final Note

We're not looking for someone who just answers messages. We're looking for someone who:

• Makes every client feel looked after

• Communicates clearly, in writing and on calls

• Owns the follow-through



If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Organic Search Specialist
description:
Organic Search Specialist



Location: Remote working Perth, AWST time zone



Job type: Part time contract work, with the opportunity for long-term full-time contract



Hey! We're Dilate, a results-driven digital marketing agency based in Perth WA, with a world-class team and an impressive, diverse client list.



It's our mission to do great marketing for great businesses, ethically and in a way that benefits everyone involved. We want our clients to win, their customers to win, and our team to win.

We're looking for an Organic Search Specialist to own the organic channel for a portfolio of our clients. For those who excel in the role, there's the opportunity of full-time contract work in the future.



So, the job.



As an Organic Search Specialist, you'll own the organic strategy and its delivery for a portfolio of clients, working alongside the Digital Strategist who holds the overall account strategy. You'll set the plan, prioritise the work that will move performance, and deliver results.



Organic search isn't just Google any more. You'll optimise across search engines, AI platforms (AI Overviews, AI Mode, ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Copilot) and surfaces like YouTube and Google Business Profile, and pull it all together into one plan that performs.



Your work will focus on three areas: strategy and reporting, on-site visibility and content, and off-site authority and brand. Success is measured by organic conversions and sales, visibility and share of voice, and how well content in every format earns its keep.



Key responsibilities



* Build integrated 90-day plans across search, AI platforms, content and off-site activity, with effort focused on the highest-impact opportunities.

* Lead our GEO and AI search approach: test how AI Overviews, AI Mode, ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Copilot source and cite content, try new tools and tactics, and turn what works into repeatable wins for clients.

* Run keyword, competitor, topic and prompt research to find where visibility can be won.

* Own or brief technical SEO, site architecture, on-page optimisation and structured data.

* Plan and direct content in every format, briefing specialists so each topic ships as a cohesive, easy-to-cite set of assets.

* Extend optimisation to YouTube, Google Business Profile and other owned platforms where it makes sense.

* Drive quality link acquisition through competitor analysis, outreach, citations and guest posts, and feed digital PR with opportunities.

* Monitor brand mentions and sentiment, flag reputation issues early, and turn unlinked mentions into links.

* Report on what changed, why and what happens next, turning data into decisions clients can act on.



You



* Highly experienced in SEO and organic search, with a strong track record of results for clients or in-house brands.

* Current, proven knowledge of GEO and AEO, including how AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Copilot source and cite content.

* Strong technical SEO skills, including Core Web Vitals, structured data and international SEO (hreflang, multi-region).

* Solid link building and content direction experience, from outreach and digital PR to briefing specialists and judging quality.

* Proficient with GA4, Google Search Console, Semrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog and AI-visibility tools, with strong analytical and CRO skills.

* Excellent communication skills

* A stable internet connection (3 Mbps or more, with a backup), a mid-level desktop or laptop, and a working mic and webcam.



Why Dilate?



* A fully remote position, so you can work from the comfort of your home.

* Own the organic strategy for your clients, not just the to-do list.

* Work with a global team on exciting, high-impact projects.

* Be supported by a collaborative team that values innovation and results.

* We strive to be 'better every day', a philosophy that runs through everything we do.

I

f this sounds like you, we can't wait to hear from you.



Please attach a cover letter so we know you're serious. We're looking for people who want it, get it and have the capacity to do it. Tell us why that's you!



👉 Apply now to join Dilate's organic search team

Your role is to bring structure and follow-through to this workload. You’ll turn calls, voice messages,
s, photos, videos and brief instructions into clearly organised tasks, then make sure those tasks keep moving until they’re done.



This is not a traditional inbox-and-calendar Executive Assistant role. It’s a hands-on coordination and operations position for someone who can work quickly, use practical judgement, follow up confidently and take ownership without needing constant supervision.



What you’ll be doing

- Managing renovation tasks, deadlines, notes and follow-ups in ClickUp

- Turning
s, calls, voice messages, photos and site updates into clear action items

- Following up with trades, contractors, suppliers and other parties

- Maintaining contractor details, quotes, waivers, access information and property records

- Creating practical checklists, templates and SOPs

- Have a background as an estimator, builder, quantity surveyor or site supervisor (preferred), or experience in construction, renovation, property maintenance, project coordination or operations support

- Can read plans, scopes and inspection reports, and tell cosmetic work apart from work that needs a licensed trade

- Residential construction or renovation

- Construction estimating or quantity surveying

- Architecture, interior design or civil engineering

- Sourcing and coordinating trades in Australia

- Australian building, rental or property-compliance requirements



Estimator and builder backgrounds will be prioritised. We’ll also consider fast learners with strong initiative, practical judgement and a genuine interest in renovation operations.
