This is a coordination and execution role, not a creative or strategy role. You won't be d
 the event theme, the commercial model or which vendors get accepted. You will be the person who makes sure everything that was d
 actually happens, on time.



What you'll be doing

- Running the master event tracker — setting each event up, calculating task due dates from the event date, assigning tasks, checking daily, chasing what's overdue

- Sending a structured end-of-day report so management can see an event's status without opening the tracker

- Vendor administration across 20–25+ vendors per event: contracts, signatures, food safety certificates, public liability insurance, stall size, power requirements, commission arrangements, contact and social media records

- Vendor communication: welcome packs, marketing requirements, bump-in details, final briefings, one-week-out reminders, and answering routine questions from approved information

- Coordinating content creators and influencers: briefs, shoot dates, attendance, deliverables, chasing content and saving links

- Running influencer night logistics, voucher printing and distribution, and food send-outs

-
 (Klaviyo or similar) and SMS campaigns: briefing design, testing links, scheduling, recording open and click performance

-
 Event setup, social bios and pinned flyers across Instagram and TikTok

- Local outreach: community businesses, universities and TAFEs, flyer and banner distribution, local media and council invitations

- QR code and lead capture campaigns: landing page, signage, onsite testing, tagging leads by event

- Building the multi-day event run sheet and confirming every arrival time, shift and delivery against it

What we're looking for

 marketing platforms and social scheduling

What success looks like:

Location: Remote / Office

About the Role

We are seeking a sharp, highly organized, and detail-oriented Locksmith Dispatch Specialist to manage our day-to-day field operations. In this role, you will act as the operational command center—matching customer service requests with qualified field technicians, monitoring real-time job progress, handling customer communications, and managing accurate financial closing records.

The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, communicates clearly, and takes pride in airtight tracking and reporting.

Key Responsibilities

1. Technical Dispatch & Route Coordination

Review incoming emergency and scheduled service requests across automotive, residential, and commercial sectors (e.g., lockouts, car keys, rekeys, safe openings).

Assess technician skill sets, current availability, and geographic proximity to dispatch jobs to the optimal technician.

Transmit comprehensive job dispatch tickets containing customer profiles, location details, problem descriptions, and special instructions.

Enforce rapid technician response times and reassign calls promptly if confirmation windows are missed.

2. Live Job Tracking & Customer Support

Track active work orders from initial dispatch to completion (En Route, Arrived, In Progress, Completed, Rescheduled, or Canceled).

Follow up consistently with field technicians to maintain up-to-the-minute job statuses.

Step in to troubleshoot communication bottlenecks: reach out directly to customers who are unreachable by the field technician.

Manage the appointment calendar, scheduling future bookings and issuing timely dispatch reminders.

3. Data Entry, Financial Auditing & Closing

Maintain the master operational spreadsheet in real time, recording all job timestamps, status updates, and customer notes.

Review technician closing reports upon job completion, verifying collected amounts, payment methods, parts expenses, and job notes.

Accurately calculate commission splits, parts deductions, and net payouts based on established company structures.

Escalate job completions and key operational metrics to designated regional managers.

4. Weekly Reconciliation & Reporting

Compile individual technician summary reports at the close of each week (tracking assigned vs. completed jobs, gross revenue, parts cost, and net payouts).

Generate master company performance reports summarizing weekly call volume, service-type breakdowns, and company margins.

Requirements & Qualifications

Experience: 1–2+ years of experience in dispatch, logistics coordination, or high-volume customer service (prior experience in locksmith, roadside assistance, towing, or field trades dispatch is a strong plus).

Speed & Focus: Exceptional multi-tasking skills with the ability to maintain composure, prioritize urgent calls, and make rapid routing decisions.

Spreadsheet Proficiency: Strong working knowledge of Google Sheets / Microsoft Excel (data entry, basic formulas, filtering, and reconciliation).

Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills; professional, firm, and supportive when liaising with both technicians and customers.

Basic Math Skills: Comfort calculating invoice totals, percentage splits, and expense deductions accurately.

Tech Setup (if remote): Reliable high-speed internet, a dedicated quiet workspace, and a modern computer capable of managing multiple browser tabs and VoIP phone systems simultaneously.

Candidate Verification Checklist

Before submitting or publishing this posting, ensure the following parameters are confirmed:

Define shift lengths (e.g., 8-hour staggered shifts covering the 9:00 AM – 11:00 PM EST operating window).

Establish starting hourly base pay or performance incentive structure.

Confirm the application intake method (direct
, job portal link, or form submission).

title: Video Editor
description:
Social Media Video Editor

(Freelance / Gig-Based | Remote | Potential Pathway to Part-Time & Full-Time)

Are you the kind of video editor who can turn ordinary raw footage into content people actually stop scrolling to watch?



Do you understand how pacing, captions, sound effects, music, animation, visual layers, transitions and pattern interrupts work together to hold attention?



Can you take a relatively simple talking-head video and transform it into high-quality, engaging and visually dynamic social media content?



We are looking for a highly capable Social Media Video Editor to work remotely with an Australian consulting business and its owner across multiple brands and content channels.



The initial arrangement will be freelance/gig-based work at $10 AUD per hour, with the potential to develop into regular part-time work and ultimately a full-time position for the right person as our content production grows.



This is not an entry-level video editing opportunity.

We are looking for someone who already possesses the technical and creative capability to produce content to the standard demonstrated in the reference videos below.



IMPORTANT: Please Watch These Videos Before Applying



Before submitting an application, you MUST carefully watch and review the reference videos below.

These videos demonstrate the general standard, style and level of editing capability we are looking for. Pay particular attention to the use of:

- Pacing and cuts

- Dynamic captions and typography

- Sound effects and sound design

- Music

- Visual storytelling

- B-roll and supporting imagery

- Motion graphics and animation

- Background manipulation and replacement

- Layering of visual elements

- Zooms, movement and transitions

- Pattern interrupts

- On-screen graphics

- Creative use of AI-generated assets where applicable

- Overall production quality and viewer engagement



Reference Videos:

















These videos are provided purely as editing and quality references. We have no affiliation with the individuals, creators or businesses featured in them.



Please assess your skills objectively after watching them.



If you cannot confidently produce video editing at or approaching this level of quality, please do not apply.



About the Role

Your primary responsibility will be turning raw video footage, ideas and creative direction into highly engaging social media content designed to capture attention, retain viewers, strengthen a personal brand and increase engagement across multiple businesses.



Content will primarily include:

- Instagram and
 Reels

- YouTube Shorts

- Talking-head videos

- Educational and thought-leadership content

- Personal-brand content

- Promotional and marketing videos

- Longer-form YouTube content where required

- Short-form viral-style content designed around strong hooks and viewer retention



You will work directly from raw footage and creative briefs, but we don't want someone who simply waits to be told where every cut, caption or sound effect should go.



We want an editor who can think creatively about the content, understand the intended audience and message, and make intelligent editing decisions that improve the final video.



Key Responsibilities

Video Editing & Post-Production

- Edit raw footage into polished, professional and highly engaging social media videos.

- Produce short-form content for Instagram Reels,
 Reels and YouTube Shorts.

- Edit longer-form video content where required.

- Create strong pacing using cuts, zooms, transitions and visual movement.

- Remove unnecessary pauses, filler and dead space while maintaining natural delivery.

- Improve the overall visual and audio quality of raw footage.

- Repurpose longer-form footage into multiple pieces of short-form content where appropriate.



Captions, Motion & Animation

- Create visually engaging animated captions and subtitles.

- Use typography creatively to emphasise important words, ideas and moments.

- Incorporate motion graphics, animated elements and visual effects.

- Create multiple visual layers within scenes rather than relying exclusively on basic cuts.

- Manipulate or replace backgrounds where appropriate.

- Incorporate images, graphics, screenshots, B-roll and other visual assets to strengthen storytelling.

- Use animation and movement to maintain attention without making the content feel unnecessarily over-edited.



Sound Design

Sound design is an important part of this role.

You should be confident using:

- Sound effects

- Music

- Audio transitions

- Emphasis sounds

- Ambient/background audio

- Audio levelling and clean-up

- Strategic moments of silence



Sound should support the story and increase engagement rather than simply being added for the sake of it.



Creative & Retention-Focused Editing

We want someone who understands that social media editing is ultimately about attention and communication, not simply technical editing.



You should understand concepts such as:

- Strong opening hooks

- Viewer retention

- Pattern interrupts

- Pacing

- Curiosity

- Visual hierarchy

- Emotional emphasis

- Storytelling

- Maintaining visual interest

- Knowing when to make an edit – and when not to



Software & Technical Capability

Experience with some or several of the following is highly regarded:

- CapCut

- DaVinci Resolve

- Adobe Premiere Pro

- Adobe Express

- Adobe Firefly

- Adobe After Effects or similar motion graphics software

- Other professional video editing and animation platforms



We are not concerned about which particular program you prefer if the quality of your finished work meets the required standard.



Your portfolio and demonstrated editing capability will matter considerably more than a list of software on your CV.

AI Content Creation – Highly Regarded



Experience incorporating AI into video production is highly regarded, including:

- AI-generated images

- AI-generated video

- Generative fill and background creation

- AI animation

- Creating consistent characters or visual assets

- AI-assisted B-roll

- Digital AI twins or avatars

- AI-assisted video enhancement

- Other emerging generative video technologies



This is preferred rather than essential.



More important is having the curiosity and technical ability to learn and adopt new creative technologies as they emerge.



About You

You are not simply someone who knows how to operate video editing software.

You have a creative eye.

You notice the small details that separate an average social media video from a highly polished one.

You understand timing. You understand sound. You understand visual storytelling. You know when a video needs movement, when it needs another visual layer, when a caption should change, and when something needs to happen to regain the viewer's attention.

You take pride in the quality of your work and don't submit something simply because it is technically "finished".

You are also comfortable receiving feedback and making revisions without becoming defensive. The goal is always to produce the best possible final piece of content.



Most importantly, your existing portfolio should demonstrate these capabilities.



Experience & Skills

The ideal candidate will have:

- Demonstrated professional video editing experience.

- A strong portfolio of short-form social media content.

- Strong capability editing Reels, Shorts and vertical video.

- Excellent understanding of pacing and viewer retention.

- Strong captioning and typography skills.

- Excellent sound-design capability.

- Experience incorporating animations, graphics, B-roll and visual layers.

- Ability to creatively manipulate backgrounds and scenes.

- Strong attention to detail.

- Ability to follow brand guidelines and creative direction.

- Ability to work independently and meet agreed deadlines.

- Strong communication skills.

- An understanding of current social media content and editing styles.

- Cinematic editing capability is highly regarded.

- AI image/video generation experience is highly regarded.



Personal Attributes

- Highly creative with a strong visual eye

- Takes pride in producing exceptional work

- Reliable and accountable

- Strong attention to detail

- Open to feedback and revisions

- Proactive and takes initiative

- Curious and willing to experiment

- Keeps up with emerging editing styles and technology

- Understands the difference between adding effects and actually improving a video

- Able to work independently without needing constant supervision



What's on Offer

- $10 AUD per hour.

- Initially freelance/gig-based work.

- Fully remote position.

- Increasing volume of work available for a high-performing editor.

- Potential pathway from gig-based work into a regular part-time position.

- Potential longer-term pathway into a full-time position as content requirements grow.

- Opportunity to work across personal-brand, leadership, business and marketing content.

- Opportunity to experiment with modern video-editing and AI content-generation technologies.

- Opportunity to have a meaningful creative influence over how the brands' content evolves.



For the right person, we are interested in building a long-term working relationship, not simply finding someone to complete one or two videos.



How to Apply – PLEASE READ CAREFULLY

Do not submit a generic application.

Before applying, you must first watch the reference videos provided earlier in this advertisement and objectively assess whether you have the editing capability required.



If you believe you do, please submit:

1. Your CV or Resume.

2. Your video editing portfolio. Please provide direct links to examples of videos you have personally edited. We particularly want to see work that demonstrates short-form social media editing, captions, sound design, animations, visual layering, B-roll, motion graphics and creative editing.

3. A short introduction video. Please record a short video introducing yourself, telling us about your video editing experience and explaining why you believe you would be a great fit for this particular role.

4. A short written summary explaining which editing software you are strongest with and any experience you have with cinematic editing, animation, AI image/video generation or digital AI twins.

Your portfolio is essential.

Applications without relevant examples of previous video editing work will not progress.



Important Note

Please ONLY apply if you have carefully watched the reference videos and genuinely believe you already possess the technical and creative editing capability required to produce work at this standard.

This role is not intended for someone who has recently learned CapCut or Premiere Pro and wants an opportunity to practise.



We are happy for someone to grow, develop and become even better while working with us, but there must already be a strong foundation of demonstrated video editing capability.

If the examples provided feel significantly beyond your current abilities, please do not apply.

If, however, you watch them and think:

"Yes. I know how this was edited, I understand why those editing decisions were made, and I can create content like this."

Then we would genuinely like to see your work.

For the right editor, this could develop from individual projects into a consistent part-time role and potentially a long-term full-time position.

title: Customer Experience Agent - US Night Shift
description:
About Rest:



At Rest, we're redefining what comfort means through continuous innovation in form, material, and technology. We believe quality sleep is essential for overall well-being, and we're here to help people get the restful nights they deserve. Our mission is simple: Ensure Everyone Gets a Good Rest. Joining our team means becoming part of a company that pushes boundaries and leads with purpose. You'll be part of a collaborative and dynamic environment that fosters creativity and challenges the status quo. If you're looking for a place where your ideas will have a direct impact on both customer experience and business growth, you've found it.



Why You'll Love It Here:



At Rest, innovation isn't just a buzzword — it's at the core of everything we do. Our fully remote team works collaboratively, embracing innovation and providing the support and tools to help you succeed. If you're ready to make your mark in the sleep industry, we want you to be part of our journey.



About the Role:



We're looking for enthusiastic, customer-obsessed Customer Experience Agents to join our US team on the night shift. You'll be the friendly and knowledgeable voice behind Rest — supporting customers through every step of their journey, from product discovery to post-purchase care, across
, live chat, and phone.



This is a hands-on role on a small, high-ownership team. You won't be "just another agent" in a large call center: our CX team works in focused pods, sits close to operations and product, and our agents' feedback directly shapes our policies, macros, and playbooks.



It's also a role where AI is part of the job. A large share of our customer conversations are now assisted by AI, and our agents are the ones who supervise it — reviewing and improving AI-drafted replies, catching where automation gets it wrong, and flagging the gaps worth automating next. You don't need a technical background, but curiosity about AI tools will take you far here.



Schedule:



- 6 days per week, night shift

- 5 shifts × 7 hours on shift, each including a 30-minute unpaid break — 6.5 paid hours per shift

- 1 shift × 5 paid hours

- 37.5 paid hours per week total

- Shift pattern and rest day are set with your manager; some flexibility is expected around peak periods, launches, and holiday season





What You'll Be Doing:



- Maintain a positive, empathetic, and professional tone in every customer interaction

- Handle a high volume of
, live chat, and phone contacts — product and sizing questions, order changes and cancellations, shipping and delivery updates, returns, exchanges, and warranty claims

- Share overnight coverage with the rest of the night-shift team — keep response times and queue health steady, pick up where teammates leave off, and hand over cleanly at shift change

- Handle complaints with care, de-escalate calmly, and propose the right solution efficiently within policy

- Become a genuine product expert on our full bedding range so you can answer any question with confidence

- Work alongside our AI support tools — review, edit, and approve AI-generated responses; correct and improve saved replies and knowledge-base content; escalate cases where automation is giving customers the wrong answer

- Keep customer records, tags, and case notes accurate and complete in Zowie (our helpdesk/CRM), and log returns and claims correctly in our internal trackers

- Collaborate with operations, fulfillment, returns, and product teams to resolve escalations

- Work seamlessly with a global team across several time zones, using async updates and clear written handovers

- Follow established SOPs, and escalate to the CX Lead or Manager when a case calls for it

- Contribute to continuous improvement of our processes, macros, FAQs, and CX tooling

- Other job duties related to the role as required





Who You Are:



- Available for the night shift, 6 days a week, on the schedule above — this is a firm requirement, not a preference

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills; you can simplify detailed or technical information without sounding scripted

- Previous experience in customer service, phone support, or sales is ideal

- Comfortable on the phone: patient, warm, and able to hold your ground professionally in a difficult call

- Highly organized, with strong attention to detail and the judgment to prioritize when the queue is full

- Calm under pressure and adaptable in a fast-changing environment

- A proactive self-starter who brings solutions, not just problems, and a good teammate who communicates openly with the others on shift

- Tech-savvy and quick to pick up remote tools (helpdesk/CRM, chat, phone, ecommerce admin)

- Reliable high-speed internet connection, a quiet workspace, and a personal workstation with a headset



Bonus — AI knowledge is a plus:



- Hands-on experience with AI assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, or similar) in a work setting

- Experience working with an AI-assisted helpdesk or chatbot

- Comfort writing clear prompts and instructions, and a good eye for when an AI answer is confidently wrong

- Interest in helping design what gets automated next, rather than just working around it

- Passion for sleep, wellness, and helping people live better





What We Offer:



- A fast-paced, collaborative environment that fosters innovation

- The opportunity to have a direct impact on how we serve customers and how our CX function grows

- Work-from-anywhere flexibility — our fully remote workforce empowers you to create a workspace that suits your lifestyle

- A front-row seat to how AI is reshaping customer experience, and real input into how we use it

- Continuous learning and career development opportunities

- A team that values diversity, inclusion, and different perspectives

- A supportive environment that encourages personal growth and well-being





Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI):



At Rest, we believe diversity drives innovation and creates better products and experiences. Our mission to ensure everyone gets a good rest extends beyond our products — it shapes our culture. We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where every team member feels valued, supported, and empowered. We actively celebrate diverse perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences, and we encourage applications from people of all communities.

We don't just accept diversity — we celebrate it. We strive to build a company where everyone feels a sense of belonging and has the opportunity to thrive.

Core bookinlinx  workflow



Business creates packages and add-ons → creates a proposal or event → enters client/event details → bookinglinx automatically calculates pricing → sends client a private link → client reviews → signs contract → bookinglinx redirects client to the business’s connected payment provider → client returns to bookinglinx → booking is confirmed → automated reminders are sent.

description:
We are a lean PPC agency serving eCommerce brands. We are hiring a part-time Google Ads media buyer, starting with an eCom account, with scope to grow after a successful trial.

- Monitor spend, pacing, CPA & ROAS signals. Flag material risks with a recommended next step.

- Reliable estimates, clear communication and self-review. You flag missing information and scope increases before the deadline or hour cap.

- Practical AI use is welcome. You verify facts, settings and proposed changes and remain accountable for the final work.



How to apply

(2) what you personally did and how results was measured;

(3) your rate, current workload, weekly capacity and exact overlap;

Shortlisted candidates complete a brief reasoning screen, a short interview and a paid, limited-scope trial with one revision. The trial focuses on one campaign and a usable change request. No full account audit is required in your application.

title: Construction Estimator
description:
Senior Construction Estimator / Tendering & Opportunities Specialist



**Remote | Part-Time Initially, Progressing to Full-Time | Australian Commercial Construction



Rapid Modular is a Western Australian commercial construction company delivering modular and traditional construction projects across education, childcare, commercial, government and industrial sectors.



We are seeking a **high-level Senior Construction Estimator / Tendering Specialist** who can not only prepare detailed commercial tenders, but also proactively identify and pursue suitable project opportunities.



This role will commence on a part-time basis, with the clear intention of progressing to a full-time long-term position for the right person based on performance, capability, workload and contribution to the business.



This is a senior, commercially focused role.



We are not looking for a junior estimator, basic quantity take-off operator or someone who waits to be given work.



We need someone who understands Australian commercial construction, can identify suitable tenders in the market, assess whether they are worth pursuing, and then take ownership of preparing a competitive and professional submission.



Key Responsibilities



- Tender Opportunity Search & Pipeline



* Proactively search for suitable Australian commercial construction opportunities

* Monitor tender portals, procurement platforms and industry sources

* Identify projects suitable for Rapid Modular's capabilities and target markets

* Search for opportunities across education, government, childcare, commercial, industrial and modular construction

* Identify upcoming projects before formal tender release where possible

* Research builders, architects, project managers, consultants and potential clients involved in upcoming projects

* Maintain a live tender and opportunity pipeline

* Track EOI dates, closing dates and prequalification opportunities

* Provide initial bid / no-bid recommendations

* Identify subcontract, head contractor and Design & Construct opportunities

* Assist with registrations, expressions of interest and prequalification submissions



We want someone who regularly brings opportunities to management rather than waiting for management to find them.



Estimating & Tendering



* Prepare detailed commercial construction estimates

* Review architectural, structural, civil and services documentation

* Prepare detailed quantity take-offs and BOQs

* Develop complete trade-by-trade scopes

* Prepare subcontractor and supplier RFQs

* Analyse and level subcontractor quotations

* Identify exclusions, qualifications and scope gaps

* Identify construction risks and tender assumptions

* Price preliminaries, supervision, cranage, transport, temporary works and site establishment

* Prepare tender clarifications and qualifications

* Prepare detailed tender breakdowns and cost plans

* Assist with value engineering and alternative construction solutions

* Review tender documentation for commercial risk

* Maintain estimating databases and historical rates

* Assist with tender programmes and construction methodology

* Support preparation of high-quality client-facing tender proposals



Essential Experience



Applicants must have:



* Significant Australian commercial construction estimating experience

* Strong knowledge of Australian construction methods, terminology and procurement

* Previous experience preparing major commercial tenders

* Experience working with or tendering to top-tier or major Australian commercial contractors

* Strong understanding of subcontract trade packages

* Ability to independently review a complete tender package and determine the full scope

* Proven ability to proactively identify tender and construction opportunities

* Familiarity with Australian tender portals and procurement systems

* Strong construction sequencing and methodology knowledge

* Excellent quantity take-off skills

* Experience analysing subcontractor quotations

* Strong Excel capability

* Excellent written English

* High commercial awareness

* Excellent attention to detail



Highly Desirable



Experience with:



* Government procurement

* Education construction

* Childcare facilities

* Commercial offices

* Industrial projects

* Design & Construct

* Modular and prefabricated construction

* Civil and site works

* Services coordination

* TenderLink, VendorPanel, AusTender and similar procurement platforms

* CostX, Cubit, Buildsoft, Bluebeam or similar estimating software

* Expressions of Interest and prequalification submissions

* Tender clarifications, exclusions and departures

* Head contract tender submissions

* Lump sum commercial tenders



The Person We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who thinks commercially, takes ownership and is naturally proactive.



You should be capable of:



* Finding suitable opportunities without being instructed where to look

* Determining whether a tender is genuinely worth pursuing

* Understanding where Rapid Modular may have a competitive advantage

* Identifying missing scope and commercial risk

* Recognising conflicting or incomplete consultant documentation

* Finding trade interface gaps

* Challenging unrealistic allowances

* Identifying site access and logistics risks

* Identifying latent condition and temporary works exposure

* Developing sensible tender qualifications

* Following up subcontractors, suppliers and outstanding information without constant supervision



You must be able to think like a commercial builder and tender manager, not simply a quantity surveyor or take-off operator.



If there is a suitable opportunity in the market, we want you to find it.



Working Arrangement



This position will initially commencepart-time, with hours increasing as the successful candidate demonstrates capability and as our tender and project workload grows.



Our objective is to develop the right candidate into a full-time senior estimating and tendering position within Rapid Modular.



For a strong performer, this role has the potential to grow beyond estimating and contribute directly to tender strategy, procurement, opportunity identification and business growth.



You will have access to work directly with the design team, senior project management and the Director.



How to Apply



Please provide:



1. A brief introduction

2. Your current location

3. Total years of construction estimating experience

4. Details of your Australian construction experience

5. Australian contractors or organisations you have previously worked with

6. Examples of commercial projects you have estimated

7. Typical project values you have worked on

8. Experience preparing top-tier commercial tender submissions

9. Examples of how you have previously identified or sourced new tender opportunities

10. Australian tender portals and procurement platforms you are familiar with

12. Your expected hourly and monthly rate

13. Your current availability

14. How many hours per week you can initially commit to the role



Please also provide examples of BOQs, estimating schedules, tender documentation or submissions you have personally prepared, with confidential information removed where necessary.



Please start your application with:



RAPID ESTIMATOR



Applications that do not include this will not be considered.



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a video interview and may be required to complete a paid practical estimating and opportunity-identification assessment based on Australian commercial construction.

title: Experienced Automotive Video Editor | YouTube Long-Form, Shorts & Reels
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION



We are looking for a highly experienced, creative, and efficient video editor to join our automotive content team for a long-term position.



Our content focuses on automotive builds, racing, drifting, modifications, and behind-the-scenes projects. We produce both long-form YouTube videos and short-form content for Instagram,
, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts.



We need someone who understands storytelling, audience retention, pacing, and efficient editing workflows. Some projects involve several hours of raw footage, so the ability to quickly review, organize, and identify valuable content is essential.



We are not looking for a beginner. We need an editor who can work independently, make creative decisions, and consistently deliver professional-quality content without extensive direction.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Long-Form Video Editing

- Edit engaging YouTube videos covering automotive builds, racing events, shop projects, and other automotive content.

- Efficiently review and organize multiple hours of raw footage.

- Identify important moments, eliminate unnecessary footage, and create a compelling storyline.

- Maintain strong pacing, smooth transitions, and viewer engagement throughout each video.

- Incorporate music, sound effects, B-roll, graphics, and other elements where appropriate.

- Understand YouTube audience retention and edit accordingly.



Short-Form Content

- Identify and extract engaging moments from long-form footage to create YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels,
 Reels, and TikToks.

- Create independent short-form videos from separately provided footage.

- Develop attention-grabbing hooks within the first few seconds.

- Add captions, sound design, and engaging visual elements when appropriate.

- Understand current short-form editing styles without relying on excessive effects or unnecessary transitions.



Workflow & Efficiency

- Quickly review large amounts of footage without missing important moments.

- Maintain organized project files and editing timelines.

- Work independently with minimal supervision.

- Meet agreed-upon deadlines and communicate progress consistently.

- Handle feedback and revisions efficiently.

- Proactively suggest creative improvements.



REQUIREMENTS



- Proven professional video editing experience with a strong portfolio.

- Strong experience editing both long-form YouTube videos and short-form social media content.

- Ability to efficiently process hours of raw footage.

- Excellent storytelling skills and understanding of viewer retention.

- Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, or similar professional software.

- Strong understanding of audio mixing, color correction, pacing, and transitions.

- Good written English communication skills.

- Reliable internet connection and computer capable of handling high-resolution footage.

- Strong attention to detail and ability to meet deadlines.

- Ability to take initiative rather than waiting for step-by-step instructions.



Automotive knowledge is strongly preferred. Familiarity with motorsports, vehicle modifications, racing, and automotive YouTube content is a significant advantage.



WORK DETAILS



- Position: Part-time initially, with potential for full-time

- Location: Remote

- Schedule: Flexible, with consistent deadlines

- Compensation: Based on experience, skill level, and output

- Opportunity: Long-term, ongoing work



HOW TO APPLY



Please include the following information in your application:



1. Portfolio: Links to your best long-form YouTube edits and short-form videos. Clearly identify videos you personally edited.

2. Experience: How many years have you been editing professionally?

3. Software: What editing software do you primarily use?

4. Turnaround Time: Approximately how long would it take you to turn 3–4 hours of raw footage into a polished 15–25-minute YouTube video?

5. Workflow: Briefly explain how you efficiently review hours of footage and identify the best moments.

6. Automotive Experience: Have you edited automotive or motorsports content before? If so, provide examples.

7. Availability & Rate: Your weekly availability and expected hourly or project-based rate.



Important: Begin your application with the word "MOTORSPORTS" so we know you have read the entire job description.



TRIAL EDIT / SKILL ASSESSMENT



Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a brief, unpaid trial edit as part of our hiring process.



The purpose of this assessment is to evaluate your editing style, storytelling ability, pacing, creativity, and ability to follow instructions.



Any unpaid assessment will be limited in scope, clearly communicated in advance, and used strictly for evaluation purposes. Trial edits will not be published or used commercially.



More extensive editing assessments or production-ready projects will be compensated.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



We value quality, speed, creativity, and consistency.



The ideal candidate doesn't simply assemble clips. They understand how to transform raw footage into engaging content that keeps viewers watching.



We're looking for someone who takes ownership of their work, understands what makes automotive content entertaining, and can become a dependable long-term member of our content team.

, database, and relationship marketing

s, and approved CRM campaigns.

• Distinguish engagement metrics from business results.

• Recommend practical tests with defined objectives and use findings to improve future campaigns.

• Evaluate whether new tools and production methods save time or improve results enough to justify their cost.



WHAT WE EXPECT



You can take an agreed plan and move it forward without repeated reminders.



You ask questions when direction is unclear, communicate obstacles early, and bring possible solutions.



You are comfortable respectfully challenging an idea—even the owner’s—when you believe another approach better supports our goals or budget.



You stay informed about what is working in social media and can explain how it could apply to WHT. You understand that popularity alone does not make a trend appropriate for our brand.

title: Illustrator / Character Designer
description:
Illustrator Wanted – Monster Character Design for New Food Brand



Project: Mini Monster (Working Name)

Industry: Food & Beverage / Mini Dutch Pancakes

Deadline: Urgent – October 2026



We're looking for a talented and creative character illustrator / mascot designer to help bring an exciting new food brand to life!



We're launching a brand dedicated to mini Dutch pancakes, currently working under the name Mini Monster.



Our vision is to create a fun, bold, colourful and instantly recognisable brand built around a family of unique monster characters.



The Concept



We want to create a collection of adorable, quirky and mischievous monsters, each representing a different mini pancake flavour.



For example:



Biscoff Monster – Inspired by Biscoff biscuits and caramel tones.



Strawberry Monster – A playful pink or red strawberry-inspired character.



The OG Monster – Our original signature monster.



Nutella Monster – A chocolate-inspired character.



Cookies & Cream Monster – A fun cookies-and-cream-inspired character.



These are examples only, and we're open to creative ideas!



Each monster should have its own unique personality, expression and characteristics, while still looking like part of the same family.



Illustration Style



We're looking for characters that are:



Cute, quirky, cheeky and full of personality.



Bold, colourful and visually striking.



Modern and playful, but not overly childish.



Memorable and instantly recognisable.



Suitable for both children and adults.



Designed with clean shapes and strong outlines that reproduce well across different sizes.



We particularly love bright green and pink, but we're open to a wider colour palette for the individual monsters.



We'll provide AI-generated concept images as visual references to communicate the direction we're exploring. However, we want original, professionally illustrated characters, not copies of the AI concepts.



Where the Characters Will Be Used



The illustrations will become a major part of our brand identity and feature across:



Marquee and event stall signage



Menu boards



Pancake packaging, cups and boxes



Stickers and merchandise



Social media and marketing campaigns



Website and promotional material



It's important that the characters work individually and together as a recognisable collection.



Project Deliverables



We're looking for an illustrator who can help with:



Developing our main signature Mini Monster mascot.



Creating a consistent character style for the brand.



Designing additional flavour-inspired monster characters.



Providing character variations or expressions where appropriate.



Supplying final artwork in editable vector formats (AI, EPS or SVG), along with transparent PNG files.



We'd also like full commercial usage rights for the final approved illustrations, including permission to use and adapt them across packaging, signage, merchandise and future marketing.



Timeline – Urgent



We're launching before the end of October, so we're working with a very tight deadline.



Our goal is to have the main character and initial monster designs completed by 15 October, as our graphic designer needs to incorporate them into the marquee, menus and packaging for printing.



We're happy to approach this in stages, starting with the main mascot and priority flavour characters, followed by additional characters as the brand develops.



Who We're Looking For



Ideally, someone who:



Has experience creating original mascots or cartoon characters.



Has a strong portfolio of fun, colourful character illustrations.



Can create a consistent family of characters.



Understands commercial branding and print requirements.



Can work quickly and communicate clearly.



Is available to start immediately.



To Apply



Please send us:



Examples of previous mascot or character illustration work.



Your availability to start immediately.



An estimated turnaround time.



Your pricing for a main mascot and a collection of approximately 5 characters.



Confirmation that you can provide editable vector files and full commercial usage rights.



We're looking for someone who can help us build something special, not just a one-off illustration. Ideally, we'd love to develop an ongoing relationship as we introduce new flavours, characters and products.



We'd love to see your creativity and bring the Mini Monster family to life!

title: # Small Business Strategy Consultant — Business Diagnosis, Smart Budgeting & Growth
description:
**Job Type:** Freelance / Independent Contractor  

**Engagement:** Hourly or per-session, on demand  

**Application Method:** OnlineJobs.ph application portal



## About the Role



I am looking for an experienced business strategist who can help me understand what is holding my businesses back, identify problems I may not see myself, and make smarter decisions about how to allocate my time, money, and resources.



I am involved in multiple business activities and projects, work with virtual assistants, and handle many responsibilities myself. I know how to perform many of these tasks, but I need an experienced, analytical person who can look at the bigger picture and help me determine what makes the most sense for my current stage of business.



**My biggest priority is finding someone who can accurately diagnose problems, identify opportunities, and recommend the right solutions—not simply give generic business advice.**



I want someone who understands that running a business is about making the best decisions with the resources available, not automatically hiring more people, spending more money, or pursuing every opportunity.



## Key Responsibilities



### 1. Business Diagnosis

- Analyze my current business activities, workload, staffing, and processes.

- Identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks, wasted time, unnecessary expenses, and poor allocation of resources.

- Determine the underlying causes of problems rather than just addressing symptoms.

- Identify issues or opportunities I may have overlooked.

- Help me understand why certain activities are not producing the results I expect and what should change.



### 2. Smart Budgeting and Resource Allocation

- Help me determine where my money, time, and resources should be invested.

- Evaluate whether a task should be handled by me, delegated to an existing VA, assigned to a more experienced person, or discontinued.

- Determine when paying more for a capable person is worthwhile and when a lower-cost solution makes more sense.

- Recommend which projects deserve investment, which should be postponed, and which are not worth pursuing.

- Help me establish a practical budgeting and expense-tracking system, even though I do not yet have complete financial records.

- Help me make sound decisions when information is incomplete and resources are limited.



### 3. Pricing, Profitability, and Revenue Growth

- Help me determine when to raise my prices and how much to charge for my products or services.

- Evaluate whether my current pricing adequately accounts for costs, time, effort, and the value delivered to customers.

- Identify opportunities to increase profit without necessarily increasing workload or expenses.

- Help me understand which services, products, customers, and business activities are most worthwhile.

- Recommend when to change an offer, introduce a new service, discontinue an unprofitable activity, or focus more heavily on something that is working.

- Help me think through pricing changes, customer retention, profit margins, and sustainable revenue growth.



### 4. Business Planning and Structure

- Help organize my businesses, projects, priorities, and responsibilities.

- Recommend how work should be distributed and where clearer processes or accountability are needed.

- Identify unnecessary roles, overlapping responsibilities, or tasks that consume too much of my time.

- Develop a realistic plan based on my current resources, with clear priorities and actionable next steps.

- Help me distinguish between problems that require immediate attention and issues that can wait.



### 5. Sustainable Growth

- Help me build a stronger business foundation before expanding.

- Explain how staffing, spending, pricing, and priorities should change as revenue and workload increase.

- Help me evaluate opportunities objectively rather than making decisions based on assumptions or excitement alone.

- Develop strategies appropriate for my current stage, with a clear understanding of what should change as the businesses grow.



## Examples of Questions I Need Help Answering



These are examples of the types of questions and decisions I may bring to consultations. They are not an exhaustive list.



**Staffing and delegation**

- Should I spend money on another VA, improve an existing employee's responsibilities, or eliminate the role?

- Am I doing tasks myself that someone else should handle?

- Is it worth paying more for a more experienced person if doing so saves time or produces better results?

- How should I divide responsibilities so that I am not constantly supervising or correcting work?



**Budgeting and spending**

- Which business activity deserves my next dollar, and which should receive nothing for now?

- Is a task or project worth pursuing given the time and money it consumes?

- How should I allocate money when I do not yet have complete financial records?

- Should I invest in a new opportunity or strengthen an existing business first?

- Where might I be spending money without receiving enough value in return?



**Pricing and profitability**

- When should I raise my prices, and how should I determine the right increase?

- Am I charging enough for the value I provide?

- How can I increase profitability without simply working more hours?

- Should I change my pricing model, minimum order, packages, or service offerings?

- Which services or customers are worth prioritizing, and which consume too many resources for too little return?



**Planning and growth**

- What should I prioritize over the next 30, 60, or 90 days?

- How can I create a budget that adapts as my revenue, workload, and opportunities change?

- Should I expand a particular activity now or wait until the business is more stable?

- What systems should I establish first so growth does not create more chaos?

- How should my strategy change as the business earns more and can afford additional resources?



I need someone who can analyze each situation, explain the reasoning behind their recommendation, identify the trade-offs, and help me d
 on a practical next step. I do not expect every question to have an obvious answer, but I do expect thoughtful analysis rather than generic advice.



## Who I Am Looking For



The ideal candidate has substantial experience advising or operating small businesses, preferably founder-led, bootstrapped, or service-based businesses.



You should have strong business judgment, analytical thinking, and the ability to make practical recommendations based on incomplete information.



I am particularly interested in someone who:

- Understands business strategy, operational efficiency, budgeting, cost-benefit analysis, pricing, profitability, and resource allocation.

- Has experience identifying the root causes of business problems and recommending measurable improvements.

- Understands virtual assistants, outsourcing, staffing, and the economics of hiring.

- Can evaluate whether an expense is justified by the value it creates.

- Understands the challenges of running a business without unlimited capital.

- Can challenge my assumptions and explain when a different approach makes more sense.

- Can distinguish between what needs to be fixed immediately, what can wait, and what is not worth pursuing.

- Can teach me how to think through business decisions, not just tell me what to do.



Experience in recruitment, marketing agencies, virtual assistant businesses, or other service-based businesses is a plus.



I am not looking for someone who simply agrees with me or provides motivational coaching. I want independent thinking, sound judgment, and practical business advice.



## Engagement Structure



This is not a full-time position and does not require a monthly retainer.



I want to work with the consultant on an as-needed basis.



**Initial engagement:** A paid business assessment focused on diagnosing the main problems, evaluating my current structure, and developing a prioritized action plan.



**Ongoing engagement:** Individual paid consultations whenever I need advice on a business decision, staffing issue, budget allocation, pricing question, new opportunity, or operational problem.



As the businesses grow and become busier, I may need consultations more frequently.



We will begin with a **free 15-minute introductory call** to assess mutual fit. Paid work will begin only after we agree on the scope and price.



## Compensation



I am willing to pay for genuine expertise and valuable results. I am not necessarily looking for the cheapest candidate.



Please state your rates clearly:

- Hourly consultation rate.

- Price for a standard 60-minute session.

- Estimated fixed fee for the initial diagnostic assessment and action plan.

- Any minimum booking requirements.



The initial assessment should have a clearly defined scope, deliverables, and total price agreed upon in advance.



## How to Apply



Please apply through the OnlineJobs.ph application portal and answer these questions:



1. **Relevant experience:** Describe your experience advising or operating small businesses. What types of businesses have you worked with?

2. **Business diagnosis:** Give one specific example of a problem you identified that the business owner had not recognized. How did you discover the underlying issue, what did you recommend, and what was the outcome?

3. **Budgeting and resource allocation:** Describe a situation where you helped a business d
 where to spend less, invest more, delegate differently, or discontinue an activity. What was your reasoning?

4. **Pricing and profitability:** Describe a situation where you helped a business improve its pricing, margins, or profitability. What did you analyze, and what changed as a result?

5. **Working with incomplete information:** How would you begin diagnosing a business when the owner does not yet have complete financial records or a formal budgeting system?

6. **Rates and availability:** Provide your hourly rate, 60-minute session price, estimated fee for the initial diagnostic assessment, and availability for a free 15-minute introductory call. Confirm that you are comfortable working on a one-off, on-demand basis without a required monthly retainer.



Please keep your answers specific and concise. Concrete examples and demonstrated results are more important than general claims about your abilities.



Thank you. I look forward to reviewing your application.



Join our group for more job updates

title: Full-Time AI Creative Strategist & Video Editor
description:
Full-Time AI Creative Strategist & Video Editor



Background



We’re a fast-growing social media agency producing high-performing short-form content across Instagram,
, YouTube, and more. WE’RE SCALING FAST!!



This isn't just a job. As the agency grows, the team grows with it. More clients means more volume, higher bonuses, and bigger opportunities for the people who helped build it. We believe in rewarding the people who show up, execute well, and grow with us and we're looking for someone who wants to be part of that from the ground floor.



We’re hiring a full-time AI Creative Strategist to analyze social media data from posted videos, understand content and marketing on a fundamental level, create raw AI clips, and assemble them into polished short-form videos using our internal workflows.



This is a strategy AND execution role. You’ll be taught from the ground up how to actually think like a creator - not just how to follow instructions.



If you haven't used every tool on our stack yet, that's okay. We care much more about having a hunger to learn, strong English, and your ability to improve independently. We'll give you the resources - what you do with them is up to you.



What You'll Do



Creative Strategy & Data

- Analyze the performance of posted videos and understand WHY certain content wins or loses

- Use data to create a feedback loop and continuously improve future videos

- Identify winning hooks, formats, angles, pacing, and creative patterns

- Research competitors, audiences, trends, and high-performing content

- Come to us with what you've learned, what you've changed, and where you need advice - not wait for us to tell you what to do 



Copywriting & Content

- Understand the fundamentals of hooks, storytelling, retention, persuasion, and customer psychology

- Write and improve short-form scripts based on research and performance data

- Identify weaknesses in scripts and creatives before production

- Develop new ideas and angles instead of simply recreating existing content

- Adapt content to different brands, audiences, and niches 



Video Editing

- Turn raw footage and AI-generated assets into high-retention short-form content

- Edit in CapCut with strong pacing, captions, B-roll, overlays, sound design, and visual storytelling

- Develop a strong creative eye and independently identify what needs improvement

- Maintain quality and consistency across multiple client accounts

- Apply feedback quickly and make sure the same mistakes don't keep happening 



AI Content Creation

- Generate AI images, videos, avatars, voices, and other creative assets using our tools

- Use tools such as ChatGPT, Grok, Veo3, and others as part of the creative process

- Experiment with new tools and workflows as AI technology evolves

- Quality check all AI outputs before using them in content

- Learn how to get better outputs instead of relying on us to provide every prompt or solution 



General

- Manage multiple projects without missing deadlines

- Communicate proactively about progress, ideas, problems, and results

- Take ownership of your work from research to final output

- Constantly look for ways to improve your own skills and the team's content

- Solve problems independently before immediately asking for help 



Requirements



Must-Haves

- EXTREMELY STRONG ENGLISH - WRITTEN, SPOKEN, AND COMPREHENSION

- GROWTH MINDSET AND GENUINE HUNGER TO LEARN!!!! 

- Experience editing short-form content - PORTFOLIO REQUIRED

- Strong WiFi connection with rare occurrences of outages

- Strong proficiency in CapCut

- Strong attention to detail and creative quality

- Able to think critically and understand WHY content performs

- Comfortable working with data and using it to improve creative decisions

- Willing to learn copywriting, marketing, AI, editing, and content strategy

- Extremely proactive - you should be coming to us with improvements, not waiting for us to find your mistakes

- Able to research and teach yourself when you don't know something

- Able to take feedback without ego and immediately apply it

- Willing to go above and beyond what is directly assigned

- Able to manage multiple projects without missing deadlines

- Reliable internet and dedicated workspace

- Currently working with NO OTHER CLIENTS. All work commitment should be on this role.



Nice-to-Haves

- Previous agency or content production experience

- Copywriting or direct-response marketing experience

- Experience analyzing social media performance data

- Strong understanding of hooks, pacing, retention, and storytelling

- Experience with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Grok, Veo3, Kling, or similar tools

- Experience researching competitors, customers, and markets

- Strong understanding of internet culture and social media trends



What We Offer

- Stable, full-time remote role with consistent workload

- Access to all required AI and editing tools

- Copywriting, marketing, editing, and creative strategy resources

- Direct feedback and mentorship on your work

- Access to real performance data so you can understand what actually works

- Freedom to test ideas, experiment, and develop your own creative instincts

- Opportunity to develop skills across editing, AI, copywriting, data analysis, and strategy

- Growth opportunities as we scale

- Performance bonuses of up to 40% of monthly pay.



How to Apply



Include all of the following. INCOMPLETE APPLICATIONS WILL NOT BE REVIEWED:

- Start your application with the word “GROWTH”

- Portfolio or reel (Drive, Notion, or direct links)

- 2-3 of your best short-form content edits

- What AI tools have you used before?

- Short answer (3-5 sentences): If one of your videos significantly underperformed compared to the others, how would you figure out what went wrong and improve the next one?

- Short answer (3-5 sentences): Tell us about something you taught yourself without being asked. How did you learn it?

- Your timezone + working hours

No portfolio = no review.

title: Hiring: Advanced IT Troubleshooting Specialist (Freelance)
description:
We are looking for a highly technical, resourceful, and experienced IT specialist to diagnose and resolve a complex web application access issue. The ideal candidate has strong expertise in networking, server infrastructure, VPN technologies, IP address analysis, and remote-access configurations. This is a results-oriented freelance project for someone who can independently investigate the root cause, develop a reliable solution, and demonstrate that the issue has been resolved.



Project Overview



We are experiencing an access restriction when attempting to access a web-based platform. The system displays a message indicating that access is restricted based on geographic location or network configuration.



We have already explored basic troubleshooting and are looking for someone with deeper technical knowledge who can identify the underlying cause and recommend or implement an appropriate solution.



Key Responsibilities



Diagnose the root cause of geographic and network-based access restrictions.

Investigate IP address classification, DNS resolution, routing, and network connectivity.

Evaluate VPN Configurations, remote desktop solutions, VPS infrastructure, and other relevant technologies.

Assess whether server location, hosting-provider IP ranges, or network policies contribute to the issue.

Identify the most effective, stable, and secure technical solution.

Implement and test the agreed solution in an authorized environment.

Provide a concise explanation of the root cause, solution, and any ongoing maintenance requirements.



Required Technical Expertise



Applicants should have demonstrable experience with:

Advanced networking and TCP/IP troubleshooting.

VPN technologies, routing, DNS, and public IP address analysis.

Linux server administration, particularly Ubuntu.

VPS deployment, configuration, and remote-access infrastructure.

Browser and web application troubleshooting.

Network security, access-control policies, and diagnostic tools.

Root-cause analysis for complex connectivity and access issues.

Experience with cloud infrastructure, remote desktop environments, and geographic or network-based access controls is a strong advantage.



Project Deliverables



The successful freelancer must:

Identify the underlying cause of the access issue.

Implement a technically sound and secure solution that complies with the service's access policies.

Demonstrate successful access using an authorized test account or approved testing method.

Provide a brief technical handover documenting the configuration and steps taken.

Explain any limitations, recurring costs, or ongoing support requirements.

Compensation and Payment Terms



Fixed project fee: $250 USD.



Payment will be released only after the agreed issue has been successfully resolved, the solution has been demonstrated, and the deliverables have been provided.



Please apply only if you are comfortable working on a results-based project with a clearly defined acceptance criterion.



Any additional hosting, software, or subscription costs must be approved in advance and are not included in the $250 project fee.



How to Apply



Please include the following in your proposal:

A brief summary of your relevant technical experience.

Examples of similar networking, VPS, VPN, or web access troubleshooting projects you have completed.

Your proposed diagnostic approach.

An estimated timeline for identifying and resolving the issue.

Confirmation that you accept the fixed $250 USD payment upon successful completion.

We are looking for someone who is genuinely technically proficient, analytical, discreet, and capable of solving complex problems independently.



Important: We are seeking a legitimate, secure, and policy-compliant solution—not simply a temporary workaround.

title: B2B Cold Caller, Sales / Lead Generation Specialist, Appointment Setter, VA
description:
About the Role





We are looking for a highly motivated B2B Sales & Lead Generation Virtual Assistant to help generate new business opportunities for a U.S.-based telecommunications Account Executive which is T-Mobile



The ideal candidate is comfortable making high-volume outbound calls, researching businesses, speaking with owners and decision-makers, handling objections, qualifying prospects, and booking appointments.



This is a performance-driven sales position. Your success will be measured by the number and quality of qualified appointments you generate.



Key Responsibilities



1. Lead Generation



* Research and identify small and mid-sized businesses.

* Build targeted prospect lists using Google Maps, Google Search, business directories, LinkedIn, and other sources.

* Identify the business owner, manager, office manager, or person responsible for wireless/telecommunications.

* Find business phone numbers and available contact information.

* Prioritize businesses that are likely to have multiple employees, company phones, tablets, hotspots, or fleet vehicles.



2. Cold Calling



* Make outbound B2B calls to business prospects.

* Introduce our telecommunications solutions professionally.

* Quickly identify whether the business is a potential fit.

* Ask discovery questions about their current wireless provider, number of lines, monthly spending, and pain points.

* Handle common objections professionally.

* Generate interest without being overly aggressive.



3. Appointment Setting



* Book qualified appointments directly on the Account Executive’s calendar.

* Confirm the appointment with the prospect.

* Send follow-up messages when appropriate.

* Maintain accurate appointment notes.

* Make sure appointments meet the agreed qualification criteria.



4. Follow-Up



* Follow up with prospects who aren’t ready to speak immediately.

* Re-contact previous leads.

* Maintain a structured follow-up schedule.

* Track conversations and outcomes in the CRM/spreadsheet.



5. Sales Intelligence

The VA should identify opportunities such as:



* Businesses with 5+ employees

* Multiple business phone lines

* Companies with fleet vehicles

* Construction companies

* HVAC companies

* Plumbing companies

* Electrical contractors

* Landscaping companies

* Pest control companies

* Roofing companies

* Delivery/courier companies

* Property management companies

* Medical/dental offices

* Professional-service businesses

* Salons/barbershops

* Other businesses likely to have multiple wireless users



Ideal Candidate



We’re looking for someone who:



* Has B2B cold-calling experience

* Has appointment-setting experience

* Has strong spoken English

* Sounds confident and professional on the phone

* Is comfortable making 50–100+ outbound calls per day

* Can handle rejection without becoming discouraged

* Understands basic sales psychology

* Can identify decision-makers

* Can overcome common objections

* Is organized and detail-oriented

* Can work independently

* Has reliable internet and a quiet workspace

* Is comfortable using Google Sheets/Excel, CRM systems, and communication tools

* Is highly motivated by performance and results



Performance Expectations



Daily targets:



* 50–100+ outbound calls

* 20+ meaningful conversations when possible

* 10–20+ newly researched prospects

* Consistent follow-up on previous prospects

* Accurate CRM/spreadsheet updates



Primary KPI:

Qualified appointments booked



Quality is more important than simply booking appointments. Appointments should ideally be with a business owner or decision-maker who has a legitimate need for business wireless services.



Qualification Questions



The VA should learn to determine:



1. Who is currently providing your business wireless service?

2. Approximately how many business lines do you have?

3. Are those lines company-owned or employee-owned?

4. Roughly how much does the business spend on wireless each month?

5. Are you currently under contract?

6. Are you experiencing any issues with your current provider?

7. Who makes the final decision regarding your wireless service?

8. When would you be open to reviewing another option?



The goal is not to hard-sell on the first call. The goal is to determine whether there is an opportunity and get the qualified prospect onto the Account Executive’s calendar.





If you’ve made it this far and read the role qualifications. Please send a virtual video of introducing yourself and why you are the best fit for this role.

title: Sales Operations Support Coordinator
description:
About the role



We are looking for a curious, dependable and highly organized Sales Operations Support Coordinator to help keep our sales team running smoothly.



This role combines sales administration, process compliance, product training coordination and recruitment support. You will be trusted to follow tasks through from beginning to end, ask thoughtful questions when something is unclear and ensure that no detail is overlooked.



This position is ideal for someone who takes genuine pride in their work. You should be willing to help wherever reasonably required and understand that both small administrative tasks and larger projects contribute to the success of the team.



As our business evolves, you will also be expected to learn new areas and take ownership of agreed projects and reasonable duties across the wider business. This is a varied role for someone who is adaptable, willing to contribute wherever needed and equally committed to routine responsibilities and larger projects.



Key responsibilities

* Sales processes and compliance

* Conduct regular checks to ensure the sales team follows established standard operating procedures.

* Maintain clear checklists and records of completed compliance checks.

* Identify missing steps, documentation or follow-ups and address them promptly.

* Follow each matter through to completion rather than assuming someone else will finish it.

* Provide concise updates to management on recurring issues and areas requiring attention.

* Suggest practical process improvements when gaps or inefficiencies are identified.



Product training and knowledge base

* Prepare and organize training materials for new products.

* Upload, structure and maintain content in Zoho Learn.

* Keep the company knowledge base accurate, current and easy to navigate.

* Coordinate with internal stakeholders to obtain product files, specifications, images and other required information.

* Ensure relevant team members receive everything needed for product launches and sales training.

* Track outstanding information and follow up until it is received.

* Ask questions and confirm expectations whenever instructions or product information are unclear.



Recruitment support

* Prepare and post sales recruitment advertisements on SEEK and other approved channels.

* Review applications against agreed selection criteria.

* Conduct initial candidate screening by
, phone or video call.

* Maintain accurate candidate records and prepare clear shortlists for management.

* Coordinate interviews and communicate professionally with applicants.

* Handle applicant information responsibly and confidentially.



Daily roster and attendance support

* Prepare and monitor the team’s daily break roster.

* Check arrival times and attendance against agreed schedules.

* Record exceptions accurately and follow the appropriate escalation process.

* Communicate reminders professionally, consistently and fairly.

* Maintain accurate records so information can be easily reviewed when required.



Projects and evolving priorities

* Take ownership of new operational projects and change business priorities as assigned by management.

* Clarify the required outcome, scope, priority, deadline and stakeholders before commencing unfamiliar work.

* Turn instructions into a practical action plan with clear steps, responsibilities and due dates.

* Coordinate with internal team members, suppliers or other stakeholders as required.

* Track actions, dependencies and risks and provide clear progress updates.

* Ask questions and raise potential obstacles early rather than making assumptions or waiting until a deadline is missed.

* Carry projects through from initial instruction to completion, implementation and handover.

* Create or update the relevant SOP, checklist or supporting documentation when a project introduces a repeatable process.

* When project work competes with recurring responsibilities, confirm priorities with the manager so existing duties are not silently delayed or dropped.



General Operations: 

* Monitoring operations and reporting on performance.

* Helping implement new workflows, tools and processes.

* Troubleshooting operational issues.

* Coordinating across departments and with external suppliers.

* Analyzing information and preparing useful reports.

* Supporting onboarding and SOP training.



How we expect you to work



We are looking for someone who:

* Is naturally curious and wants to understand the reason behind a task.

* Asks sensible questions when unsure instead of guessing or remaining silent.

* Listens carefully and follows instructions accurately.

* Takes responsibility for tasks from commencement through to completion.

* Pays close attention to details and checks their work before submitting it.

* Is reliable, responsible and consistent—even when working independently.

* Follows established processes rather than creating unnecessary shortcuts.

* Completes all reasonable duties within the role instead of selecting only preferred tasks.

* Approaches small routine tasks with the same care as larger projects.

* Keeps files, trackers, messages and priorities organized.

* Communicates early if a deadline may be missed or assistance is required.

* Creates clear handover notes and ensures essential processes are covered before taking leave.

* Is honest, genuine and trustworthy in their communication and work.

* Accepts feedback positively and applies it to future work.

* Closes the loop by confirming when work has been completed.



Skills and experience

* At least two years’ experience in sales administration, operations support, recruitment coordination or a similar role.

* Excellent written and spoken English.

* Strong attention to detail and follow-through.

* Confidence in politely holding people accountable to agreed processes and deadlines.

* Ability to manage several recurring responsibilities without constant supervision.

* Experience maintaining SOPs, checklists, trackers or knowledge bases.

* Sound judgement when working with confidential recruitment and attendance information.

* Competence with Microsoft Office or Google Workspace.

* Experience coordinating or managing projects from initial brief through to completion.

* Strong analytical, problem-solving and time-management skills.

* Ability to learn unfamiliar systems and processes quickly.

* Ability to work independently while knowing when to ask questions or escalate an issue.

* Experience identifying operational bottlenecks and recommending practical improvements.

* Experience with Zoho Learn, other Zoho applications, SEEK or an Australian business will be highly regarded but is not essential.



Working arrangements

* Location: Remote, Philippines

* Hours: Mondays to Fridays 9am-5.30pm

* Time zone: Australian Eastern Standard Time, including daylight-saving changes.

* Employment type: Full-time

* Salary: PHP 50,000 per month, plus 13th-month pay, paid leave and health-insurance benefits. 

* Start date: ASAP

* The successful candidate will require a reliable internet connection, a suitable home workspace and the ability to attend online meetings during the required working hours.



How to apply



Please submit:

* Your résumé.

* A short introduction explaining your relevant experience and why this role interests you.

* An example of a process, checklist, tracker or knowledge base you have maintained.

* An example of a task you managed from initial instruction through to completion.

* Your expected monthly salary in PHP.

* Your availability and notice period.



Please begin your application with the words “Sales Operations” so we know you have read the advertisement carefully.

SEO for service-area businesses

Remote

title: Illustrator / Character Designer
description:
