Industry: Food & Beverage / Mini Dutch Pancakes

Deadline: Urgent – October 2026



We're looking for a talented and creative character illustrator / mascot designer to help bring an exciting new food brand to life!



We're launching a brand dedicated to mini Dutch pancakes, currently working under the name Mini Monster.



Our vision is to create a fun, bold, colourful and instantly recognisable brand built around a family of unique monster characters.



The Concept



We want to create a collection of adorable, quirky and mischievous monsters, each representing a different mini pancake flavour.



For example:



Biscoff Monster – Inspired by Biscoff biscuits and caramel tones.



Strawberry Monster – A playful pink or red strawberry-inspired character.



The OG Monster – Our original signature monster.



Nutella Monster – A chocolate-inspired character.



Cookies & Cream Monster – A fun cookies-and-cream-inspired character.



These are examples only, and we're open to creative ideas!



Each monster should have its own unique personality, expression and characteristics, while still looking like part of the same family.



Illustration Style



We're looking for characters that are:



Cute, quirky, cheeky and full of personality.



Bold, colourful and visually striking.



Modern and playful, but not overly childish.



Memorable and instantly recognisable.



Suitable for both children and adults.



Designed with clean shapes and strong outlines that reproduce well across different sizes.



We particularly love bright green and pink, but we're open to a wider colour palette for the individual monsters.



We'll provide AI-generated concept images as visual references to communicate the direction we're exploring. However, we want original, professionally illustrated characters, not copies of the AI concepts.



Where the Characters Will Be Used



The illustrations will become a major part of our brand identity and feature across:



Marquee and event stall signage



Menu boards



Pancake packaging, cups and boxes



Stickers and merchandise



Social media and marketing campaigns



Website and promotional material



It's important that the characters work individually and together as a recognisable collection.



Project Deliverables



We're looking for an illustrator who can help with:



Developing our main signature Mini Monster mascot.



Creating a consistent character style for the brand.



Designing additional flavour-inspired monster characters.



Providing character variations or expressions where appropriate.



Supplying final artwork in editable vector formats (AI, EPS or SVG), along with transparent PNG files.



We'd also like full commercial usage rights for the final approved illustrations, including permission to use and adapt them across packaging, signage, merchandise and future marketing.



Timeline – Urgent



We're launching before the end of October, so we're working with a very tight deadline.



Our goal is to have the main character and initial monster designs completed by 15 October, as our graphic designer needs to incorporate them into the marquee, menus and packaging for printing.



We're happy to approach this in stages, starting with the main mascot and priority flavour characters, followed by additional characters as the brand develops.



Who We're Looking For



Ideally, someone who:



Has experience creating original mascots or cartoon characters.



Has a strong portfolio of fun, colourful character illustrations.



Can create a consistent family of characters.



Understands commercial branding and print requirements.



Can work quickly and communicate clearly.



Is available to start immediately.



To Apply



Please send us:



Examples of previous mascot or character illustration work.



Your availability to start immediately.



An estimated turnaround time.



Your pricing for a main mascot and a collection of approximately 5 characters.



Confirmation that you can provide editable vector files and full commercial usage rights.



We're looking for someone who can help us build something special, not just a one-off illustration. Ideally, we'd love to develop an ongoing relationship as we introduce new flavours, characters and products.



We'd love to see your creativity and bring the Mini Monster family to life!

title: Telemarketer
description:
B2B Appointment Setter & List Researcher — long-term, remote, paid hourly



THE ROLE



You call small and mid-sized businesses in Western Canada (BC and Alberta) and book short intro meetings between the person in charge of their employee benefits plan and our advisor. You are not selling insurance — you're booking a 30-minute conversation. A full operations manual, proven script and objection responses are provided.



Our clients tell us they stay with us for three things: sustainable rate savings, clarity in their coverage (no surprises at claim time), and an advisor who responds quickly, is patient, and acts in their best interest. Your call is a prospect's first taste of that experience — every call should sound like it.



This job is two jobs, and we value them equally:



-Calling (the visible half): friendly, unhurried cold calls during Pacific/Mountain business hours — gatekeepers, decision makers, objections, and booking meetings via Calendly.

-Research & data (the hidden half): verifying phone numbers and decision makers on company websites, enriching new lists before dialing, and keeping meticulous dated notes in our spreadsheet. The first pass through any new list is mostly cleanup — that is expected, and it's exactly why we pay by the hour, not per call.



YOU'RE A FIT IF



-Your spoken English is fluent and natural — you sound like a friendly colleague, not a script reader.

-You're meticulous: every dial logged the moment you hang up, dates as YYYY-MM-DD, notes a stranger could pick up and continue from.

-You're patient and steady — you'd rather build clean data and 3–6 solid meetings a week than burn through a list for volume.

-You're honest on the phone: comfortable saying “good question — that's exactly what the meeting is for” instead of bluffing.

-You want one long-term client and are reliably available during Canadian business hours.



YOU'RE NOT A FIT IF



-You're paid-per-call minded: maximum dials, minimum notes, next gig.

-You find the research/data-entry half of the work beneath you.

-Your style is pressure, exaggeration, or arguing past a “no.”



THE ONE NON-NEGOTIABLE



You are our brand to every person you reach. Protecting the brand outranks any single meeting: courteous, honest, zero pressure, on every call. “Don't call again” is honoured forever. If a call turns sour, exit politely and log it.



WHAT WE PROVIDE



A complete operations manual with scripts and objection handling, a researched call list, spreadsheet conventions, Calendly for booking, and regular debriefs and coaching directly with the principal. We invest in one caller who gets better every month.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



First two weeks: list enriched, script comfortable in your own words. Steady state: 100–150 dials a day, 15–25 real decision-maker conversations, 3–6 booked meetings a week — and a spreadsheet that's always current. Meetings booked and data quality are what we measure; dials are just how you get there.



HOW TO APPLY



Please don't send a resume or reply here — send a short video (2–3 minutes). Introduce yourself, tell us about your calling and research experience, and speak to us the way you'd speak to a business owner on a Tuesday morning. Then, so we know you actually read this page, finish your video by telling us the three things our clients say they stay with us for. Videos that skip that last part won't be considered — attention to detail is the job.



Upload video here:

This is a content coaching role first, community management second. If you can watch a skincare video and say exactly why it lost the viewer in the first second, we want to talk to you.



What you'll do

Reply individually to creators in our WhatsApp hub and TikTok/Euka inboxes real responses, never copy-paste blasts

Review incoming sample requests and approve selectively. Being disciplined matters more than being fast; every sample costs us money

Host two (2) live creator calls each week content teardowns, feedback on what people posted, and open Q&A

Coach creators on video format and give direct, specific feedback on their content

Track post rates, completion rates and conversion, and report weekly

What we're looking for

Excellent written English warm, natural and human. Our creators get a real person, never a template. This is the single most important requirement. Real understanding of short-form content and why some videos hold attention



TikTok Shop affiliate experience (seller or creator side) helpful, not essential

Confident on camera and comfortable leading a group call

Comfort with numbers post rates, completion rates, conversion

Self-directed. We'll train you on our product, our format and what works. We won't be watching your calendar





Compensation

You're paid like a sales manager: a base, plus a share of what your team produces. Your team is our creator roster the better they perform, the more you earn. No cap.



Base: $5–8/hour depending on experience, 20–25 hrs/week

Team commission: 2% of all creator-driven GMV above $1,000/month. Uncapped, paid monthly

Performance bonus up to $300/month, on what you directly control:

$100 — average video completion rate hits target

$100 — at least 15 creators post 4+ videos

$100 — at least 20 videos cross 1,000 views

Threshold schedule, stated up front: commission starts above $1,000/month. Once we clear that twice, it rises to $3,000, then $5,000. The percentage never drops — only the bar moves as the business grows



Schedule

Part-time, 20–25 hrs/week, fully remote — work the hours that suit you

Two fixed weekly creator calls at 7:00pm ET (7:00am Manila)

Creator messages answered within 12 hours on weekdays

One weekly call with the founder who is based in Bangkok, one hour from Manila, so no awkward hours on either side

Start: as soon as possible after hire

Paid 3-week trial, then ongoing. Path to full-time as the role grows



To apply

We're reviewing applications as they come in and plan to make a hire by October 24. Strong applicants will hear from us within 48 hours, so apply early.



Send us your experience, plus answers to both:



You have a skincare product and 50 creators posting for free. The first 50 videos average under 10% completion rate. What do you do, and in what order?

Send links to three TikTok Shop videos you think are excellent and three you think are weak one sentence on each explaining why.

ABOUT SHANA WALKER'S REVIEWS

We produce authentic, helpful, and engaging content showcasing everyday Amazon products. Our goal is to create high-quality videos that demonstrate products in real-world situations, answer shoppers' questions, and help viewers d
 whether a product is right for them.

We're building for the long term, and we're looking for an experienced editor who can take ownership of post-production and help us consistently produce excellent content across multiple platforms. Your editing will play an important role in the quality and growth of our brand.

This is an editing-focused position with flexible hours, starting part-time with the potential to transition to full-time as the business grows.

HOW THIS ROLE WORKS — 30-DAY PAID TRAINING PERIOD

________________________________________



All new hires begin with a paid 30-day training period. This is your opportunity to learn our systems, workflows, and standards — and for us to see how you work. At the end of the 30 days, we'll make a final hiring decision based on your performance, reliability, and fit with the team. Candidates who complete training successfully move into the role.



________________________________________

WHAT YOU'LL DO

As our Senior Video Editor, you'll own the post-production process for our Amazon, YouTube, and TikTok content. You'll use your editing expertise and creative judgment to turn raw footage into polished, engaging videos that feel authentic and keep viewers interested.

Your responsibilities will include:

Edit Amazon Influencer shoppable videos, including product reviews, demonstrations, unboxings, installations, and comparisons.

Edit long-form YouTube review and comparison videos from rough footage to final export — cuts, color, audio, motion graphics, and captions

Edit short-form TikTok videos, including talking-head content about the Amazon Influencer Program, using engaging hooks, captions, and pacing.

Build and maintain branded templates, intros/outros, and transition kits

Collaborate directly with Shana and Team on pacing, structure, and creative direction for each video

Work efficiently through 4K footage pipelines without sacrificing quality or turnaround time

Use AI-assisted tools (ChatGPT, Descript, OpusClip, etc.) to accelerate rough cut and repurposing workflows

Review thumbnail concepts and provide editing-informed feedback on click-worthiness

Manage file organization, project archives, and delivery timelines across multiple concurrent videos

Track hours and productivity using Hubstaff (required upon hire)

If applying: Include # of TikTok followers you have



________________________________________

Required:

3+ years editing YouTube or creator content professionally

Expert-level in DaVinci Resolve, Adobe Premiere Pro, or Final Cut Pro

Fast and efficient with 4K footage — you don't let a heavy timeline slow you down

Strong sense of pacing — you know when a cut is 2 seconds too long

Experience editing product demos, reviews, or comparison formats

Comfortable with AI editing tools (Descript, OpusClip)

Ability to give clear, actionable feedback and mentor junior editors

Excellent written and spoken English

Reliable internet (100 Mbps+ upload and download) and a capable 4K editing workstation

At least 1 hour overlap in MT for check-ins and training (8AM PHT)



Nice to Have:

Experience with Amazon Influencer or affiliate-focused content

Short-form editing experience (Reels, Shorts, TikTok)

Motion graphics skills in After Effects or Fusion

Understanding of YouTube retention analytics and thumbnail strategy

Familiarity with 
 or similar review/delivery platforms

Experience coordinating within a small content team



________________________________________

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We're looking for someone who understands that great editing is about more than simply cutting clips together. You should know how to make videos engaging, showcase products effectively, and maintain a natural, trustworthy feel.

Our product reviews should clearly demonstrate how products work and help shoppers understand their features and real-world usefulness. Our YouTube videos should feel polished and hold viewers' attention, while our short-form content should capture interest quickly.

The ideal candidate can take raw footage and creative direction and turn it into excellent finished videos without requiring constant supervision. We value creative judgment, reliability, consistency, and someone who takes pride in their work.

This is an editing-focused role. You will not be responsible for managing or training other editors.



________________________________________

SCHEDULE & COMPENSATION

Position: Part-Time Senior Video Editor

Hours: Approximately 20 hours per week

Compensation: $450-$600 monthly ($5–$7) USD per hour,  depending on experience and editing ability

Schedule: Flexible working hours, with at least one hour of daily overlap with U.S. Mountain Time. We anticipate coordinating a daily check-in around 6PM Mountain Time, with flexibility as needed. (8AM PHT)



Future Opportunity: Potential to transition to a full-time position as the business grows.

We value flexibility, clear communication, consistent quality, and meeting agreed-upon deadlines. Outside the daily overlap period, you'll have flexibility to organize your work around your schedule.

We're looking for someone interested in building a long-term working relationship and helping us continually improve and expand our content production.



HOW TO APPLY

 • Why you're a great fit for this role

title: Senior Accountant (Full-Time, Remote, Pacific Time)
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



You keep the books for MLA Canada, a real estate sales and marketing company based in Vancouver, Canada, and its related companies. You run full cycle accounting in Sage 50, process payroll in WorkLinks, reconcile our real estate trust accounts, and maintain the Excel and Power Query reports our leadership team relies on. This is a fully remote, hands-on role. You report to the Senior Accountant and work our regular business hours in Pacific Time (Vancouver, Canada).



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Full cycle accounting

Payroll

• Prepare the monthly budget-to-actual report and produce ad-hoc analyses when needed.



Sales tax and year end

• Prepare Canadian sales tax returns (GST and PST).

• Prepare year-end working papers and support our external accountants.



WHAT YOU BRING



Must have

• 4+ years of full cycle accounting experience.

• Experience with real estate commissions and trust accounts, including trust reconciliations.

• Hands-on payroll processing experience.

• Strong Excel and Power Query skills: building refreshable models that other people can use.

• Sage 50 or a similar accounting system, such as QuickBooks or Xero.

• Strong written and spoken English, and able to work full days on Pacific Time.



Nice to have

title: Experienced Bookkeeper – QuickBooks, AR & Revenue Reconciliation
description:
Livily is looking for an experienced Bookkeeper to maintain accurate, complete financial records in QuickBooks. This is a full-cycle bookkeeping role that includes accounts receivable, revenue recognition, and payment reconciliation.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Maintain day-to-day bookkeeping in QuickBooks, including transaction categorization, general ledger entries, and supporting documentation.

• Manage accounts receivable: prepare and track invoices, apply customer payments, monitor aging balances, follow up on outstanding amounts, and investigate discrepancies.

• Manage accounts payable: record bills, reconcile vendor statements, and track amounts due.

• Record revenue in the correct accounting period under the company’s accounting policies, including tracking deposits, advance payments, deferred revenue, refunds, and adjustments.

• Reconcile customer and reservation payments across booking records, payment processors, bank deposits, and QuickBooks. Investigate missing, duplicate, partial, or unmatched payments, fees, refunds, and chargebacks.

• Complete bank, credit card, and clearing-account reconciliations and resolve differences.

• Support month-end close, prepare adjusting journal entries, and maintain reconciliation schedules.

• Prepare accurate financial reports, including profit and loss, balance sheet, and accounts receivable aging reports.

• Work with the Head Accountant to resolve accounting issues and maintain reliable records and controls.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• At least 5 years of hands-on, full-cycle bookkeeping experience.

• At least 5 years of hands-on QuickBooks experience, including reconciliations, journal entries, and financial reporting.

• Experience covering accounts payable, accounts receivable, general ledger, month-end close, and financial statements. AR-only or collections-only experience does not meet this requirement.

• Practical understanding of accrual accounting, revenue recognition, deferred revenue, and payment reconciliation.

• Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills and confidence working with CSV files and large transaction lists.

• Strong attention to detail, clear written communication, and the ability to investigate and resolve discrepancies independently.



NICE TO HAVE

• Experience in hospitality, property management, short-term rentals, or reservation-based businesses.

• Experience reconciling booking-platform payouts and payment-processor settlements.



HOW TO APPLY

Please include your resume and answer the following:

1. How many years of full-cycle bookkeeping experience do you have, and which responsibilities did you handle?

2. How many years have you used QuickBooks, and which versions (Online, Desktop, or both)?

3. Describe your experience with month-end close and preparing financial statements.

4. Give an example of a payment reconciliation discrepancy you investigated and resolved.

5. Explain how you have handled customer deposits or advance payments before the related revenue was earned.

Please describe examples without sharing confidential client information.

title: Shopify Post Purchase CRO Specialist
description:
Who We Are:



At Escend Media, we help D2C brands implement retention strategies that increase profit and drive customer retention. We want to be the ‘who’ behind emails that people ask ‘dannngg, who designed that’.



What We Do:

We help 7 and 8 figure ecommerce businesses develop, optimize and scale their owned media marketing efforts. Whether they are just looking to start email marketing, they need to really refine what they are currently doing or they need someone to take email marketing off their shoulders, we’re here to help them so that they can focus on running the business.



Our clients are leaders in their industry and have built strong relationships with the customers they serve. Our job is to ensure that their brand image stays consistent online and offline and, more importantly, that their business is growing.





Summary of The Position:



The Shopify Post Purchase CRO Specialist is responsible for the strategic implementation and optimization of post-purchase upsell funnels, primarily utilizing platforms like Aftersell. This role focuses on enhancing Average Order Value (AOV) and Customer Lifetime Value (CLTV) for Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) e-commerce brands by creating highly relevant and effective post-purchase offers. The specialist will manage the full lifecycle of implementation, from strategic planning and A/B testing to performance monitoring and continuous optimization, ensuring seamless integration and alignment with brand objectives.



Responsibilities:



• Implement and manage post-purchase upsell funnels using platforms such as Aftersell, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives to increase AOV and CLTV.

• Conduct systematic A/B testing across various elements including product selection, offer and pricing structures, pricing angles, copywriting, psychological angles, user interface (UI) optimization, and customer segmentation.

• Monitor and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) such as Acceptance Rate, AOV Lift, Incremental Profit/Session, and Upsell Conversion Rate, optimizing for Revenue Per Visitor (RPV) and Profit Per Visitor (PPV).

• Ensure technical and creative requirements are met for all implementations, including fulfillment safety (e.g., 'Order on Hold' feature), mobile responsiveness, brand consistency, and effective inventory management.

• Collaborate with marketing and design teams to ensure brand consistency and compelling offer presentation.

• Identify and avoid common pitfalls such as the 'Wall of Text' error and the 'Irrelevance' trap, focusing on clear value propositions and relevant offers.

• Leverage customer data, loyalty programs, and other add-ons to enhance post-purchase strategies and maximize incremental revenue.

• Continuously refine and improve post-purchase strategies based on performance data and evolving market trends.



Our Culture:



• No one is bigger than the team

• We don’t make excuses, we take responsibility

• Innovate everywhere

• Communicate. Communicate. Communicate. We have a culture of open communication.



Required Skills:



• Proven experience in implementing and optimizing post-purchase upsell strategies, preferably with platforms like Aftersell.

• Strong understanding of e-commerce metrics and their impact on business growth (AOV, CLTV, ROAS, RPV, PPV).

• Demonstrated expertise in A/B testing methodologies and data-driven optimization.

• Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to quality assurance in all implementations.

• Knowledge of mobile UI/UX best practices for e-commerce.

• Ability to analyze performance data and translate insights into actionable strategies.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex ideas clearly.

• Experience with project management software (e.g., Clickup) is a plus.

• Proactive approach with a sense of urgency and purpose in daily tasks.



Perks:

- Flexible working hours

- Remote working

- Room to grow - we're an early stage start up with a proven track record

- Competitive compensation

- Work with some amazing brands



This Role Is Perfect for You If…



- You love working as a team.

- You are a self-starter.

- You can work under pressure

- You have exceptional communication skills

- You are results/outcome driven.

- You have a ‘can-do’ attitude. If “that’s not my job” isn’t in your vocabulary, you’ll fit in great!



This Role is NOT the Right Fit For You If You Are…

- A ‘me first’ type of person

- Not a self-starter.

- Not a ‘people person’

- Problem driven, not solution oriented. If you complain about problems/issues/bottlenecks, without proposing a solution, this is not for you.

- Looking for a typical 9-5. If you hate Mondays, this is not for you. We’re a mission-driven company who are all about changing the lives and businesses that we work with. If we have something that needs to get done, we’ll have all hands on deck. Sometimes you might have to work late but sometimes you’ll get the afternoon off, it’s not all work no play, but we’re here to help business grow!

title: Social Media Manager – Publishing & Audience Growth (Paid Trial)
description:
Social Media Manager – Content Publishing & Audience Growth (Paid Trial)



Position: Part-Time / Remote

Paid Trial: One Week

Compensation: $5 USD per hour

Trial Limit: 5 hours maximum ($25 total)

Opportunity: Potential Long-Term Position



About the Opportunity



We are seeking a creative, dependable, organized, and growth-oriented Social Media Manager to support our counseling, nonprofit, and faith-based initiatives.



Our organization focuses on emotional wellness, healthy relationships, marriage and family enrichment, personal development, and community outreach.



We already have a video editor who prepares much of our content. We are looking for someone who can take our completed videos, graphics, and promotional materials and effectively publish them across
, Instagram, YouTube, and TikTok.



Our goal is not simply to post content, but to build a meaningful, engaging, and growing online presence.



The ideal candidate will begin by following our content direction and potentially grow into a proactive social media manager who brings creative ideas, understands our mission, and helps expand our reach.



Phase 1: One-Week Paid Trial



The initial paid trial will focus primarily on content publishing and distribution.



Responsibilities include:



Upload and publish completed videos, graphics, and promotional materials provided by our team.



Prepare content for
, Instagram, YouTube, and TikTok, including Reels, Shorts, and standard posts.



Write engaging captions, titles, descriptions, and relevant hashtags.



Follow our content calendar, posting instructions, and brand guidelines.



Ensure content is properly formatted for each platform.



Submit posts for approval before publishing when requested.



Verify that published content displays correctly.



Provide links to published content and a brief progress report.



Communicate effectively and complete assignments within agreed deadlines.



Original video creation and advanced video editing are not required during the initial trial.



We will evaluate candidates based on accuracy, attention to detail, communication, creativity, reliability, and ability to follow instructions.



Phase 2: Potential Ongoing Social Media Management



Candidates who successfully complete the paid trial may be considered for ongoing responsibilities, including:



Developing and maintaining a consistent social media posting schedule.



Creating and managing a monthly content calendar.



Implementing strategies to organically grow followers and audience engagement.



Increasing visibility through effective captions, hashtags, platform features, and content distribution.



Monitoring audience engagement and responding to comments or messages according to approved guidelines.



Identifying opportunities to increase reach, interaction, and community participation.



Tracking social media performance and providing simple reports.



Recommending creative ideas for upcoming events, promotions, and campaigns.



Collaborating with our video editor to ensure content supports our overall goals.



Helping maintain a consistent and professional brand presence across all platforms.



We value someone who can eventually contribute ideas and recommendations rather than simply wait for instructions.



Additional Creative Skills — A Plus!



Although video editing is not required for the initial trial, we especially welcome candidates with experience in:



CapCut or other video editing software.



Creating original short-form videos, Reels, Shorts, and TikToks.



Canva graphic design and promotional materials.



Video storytelling and engaging social media content.



Social media content strategy and organic audience growth.



Meta Business Suite, YouTube Studio, and TikTok publishing tools.



Social media analytics and performance tracking.



These additional skills may provide opportunities for expanded responsibilities.



Required Qualifications



Experience publishing content on
, Instagram, YouTube, and TikTok.



Understanding of platform-specific posting formats and best practices.



Strong written English communication skills.



Ability to write professional and engaging captions.



Excellent organization and attention to detail.



Ability to follow instructions and meet deadlines.



Reliable internet access and consistent communication.



Ability to work independently while collaborating with a team.



Respect for Christian, counseling, marriage, family, and nonprofit-related content.



Willingness to learn, receive feedback, and grow professionally.



Paid Trial Details



Duration: One week

Hourly Rate: $5 USD

Maximum Hours: 5 hours

Maximum Trial Compensation: $25 USD



Candidates must not exceed five hours without prior written approval.



The trial will involve publishing and distributing content supplied by our team.



Paid Trial Challenge: 

Using up to 10 pieces of content provided by our team, develop and execute a one-week posting strategy across
, Instagram, YouTube, and TikTok. We want to see your creativity, initiative, and understanding of audience growth. You will determine the recommended posting frequency, timing, captions, and engagement approach, subject to our approval. All work must remain within the five-hour paid trial limit.



Successful completion of the trial may lead to an ongoing part-time opportunity. Future responsibilities, hours, and compensation will be discussed separately.



How to Apply



Please submit the following:



A brief introduction about yourself and your social media experience.



Your experience publishing content across
, Instagram, YouTube, and TikTok.



Links to social media accounts you have managed or examples of your previous work.



Your experience with Meta Business Suite, YouTube Studio, or other scheduling tools.



Any additional skills in CapCut, Canva, video creation, or editing.



Your availability to begin the one-week paid trial.



Please also answer this question:



If we provided you with a completed 60-second video, how would you approach publishing and promoting it across
, Instagram, YouTube, and TikTok to maximize engagement and reach?



We are looking for someone who is dependable, creative, willing to learn, and interested in growing with our organization.



If you enjoy social media, understand the importance of meaningful content, and want an opportunity to develop your skills while making a positive impact, we encourage you to apply!

We are looking for experienced phone sales closers who can confidently sell to U.S. customers and close the sale on the initial call.



If you have experience in high-volume telesales, BPO sales, direct-response sales, health & wellness, supplements, insurance, retention, or other one-call-close environments, we want to hear from you.



THE ROLE



We provide the leads.



Your job is to:



Get the customer on the phone → Build rapport → Identify the need → Build value → Overcome objections → Ask for the sale → CLOSE

title: Operations, Administration and Accounts Assistant
description:
Location: Work from Home (Philippines)

Contract Type: Independent Contractor | Part-time initially (20 hours per week), with potential to increase to full-time

Working Hours: To be agreed, aligned with Adelaide business hours



About the Business



We are seeking an experienced, highly organised and proactive Operations, Administration & Accounts Assistant to support a growing air conditioning business based in Adelaide, South Australia.



The business is an established air conditioning specialist providing installation, servicing, repairs and preventative maintenance for residential and light commercial customers across metropolitan Adelaide.



With over 20 years of industry experience, the business specialises in evaporative cooling, ducted reverse-cycle air conditioning, gas ducted heating, and light commercial air conditioning.



About the Role



We are looking for a versatile, detail-oriented and proactive administrative all-rounder to provide back-office support across operations, accounts, job management, reporting and marketing.



The role will focus on maintaining accurate information in Ascora or similar software or tools and Xero, checking job records, assisting with financial administration, preparing technician performance reports, supporting
 marketing campaigns and documenting business processes.



You will work closely with the business owner and existing office team to ensure that administrative tasks are completed accurately and on time, particularly during busy periods.



This is primarily a back-office support role. You will not be responsible for answering incoming customer calls, managing appointment bookings or directly scheduling technicians, as these responsibilities are handled by the on-site team.

The position will initially be part-time, with the opportunity to increase to full-time as the business grows and the responsibilities expand.



Key Responsibilities



1. Job Management & Operational Administration –Ascora or similar software or tools

- Review job records in Ascora or similar software or tools to ensure information is accurate, complete and up to date.

- Check that jobs are assigned to the correct technicians and that job details match the actual work completed.

- Verify that equipment and asset information, including make, model and serial numbers, has been recorded correctly.

- Review job cards, technician timesheets, materials used and supporting documents for missing or incorrect information.

- Identify incomplete jobs, outstanding information and administrative discrepancies.

- Track unfinished jobs, outstanding tasks and reminders, and pass follow-up actions to the office team.

- Check that completed jobs have been invoiced and correctly transferred from Ascora or similar software or tools  to Xero.

- Assist with entering and attaching supplier invoices to the relevant jobs.

- Identify discrepancies in job records, invoicing and payments, and report these to management.

- Help maintain accurate job data to support reliable operational and financial reporting.

- Prepare repetitive and predictable quotations for approval and finalisation by management.

- Update and upload our inventory supplier pricing using templates and files.

- Build out and maintain our price books for our technicians to quote customers on site.



2. Bookkeeping & Accounts Administration – Xero

- Complete bank feed reconciliations in Xero.

- Enter and process supplier invoices in Ascora or similar software or tools and Xero.

- Review outstanding payments, EFT transactions and invoice discrepancies.

- Assist with accounts payable and accounts receivable administration.

- Update and maintain the cash banking spreadsheet.

- Review technicians job run sheets and action items that require attention

- Prepare and update the end-of-month supplier payables spreadsheet.

-
 customer statements and follow up on overdue invoices.

- Assist with resolving outstanding invoice and payment queries.

- Prepare payroll information and supporting documentation for management approval.

- Assist with supplier payment preparation and end-of-month financial processes.

- Generate financial reports and summaries for management.

- Maintain accurate financial records and supporting documentation.



3. Reporting, KPI Tracking & Business Performance

- Generate and review reports from Ascora to ensure the accuracy of job and financial information.

- Prepare reports identifying:

  - Job booking and technician assignment discrepancies.

  - Invoices transferred from Ascora to Xero.

  - Jobs completed but not invoiced.

  - Payments not collected and outstanding invoices.

  - Technician quotes and outstanding quotation activity.

- Prepare weekly technician labour utilisation reports.

- Track technician performance against established KPIs and Key Performance Areas (KPAs).

- Update and maintain technician performance scoreboards.

- Monitor minimum and average invoice values.

- Complete monthly job data and business performance reports.

- Update lead source tracking spreadsheets.

- Compile operational reports for the business owner and Service Manager.

- Identify inconsistencies, missing information and opportunities to improve reporting accuracy.



4. Systems, SOPs & Process Improvement

- Document existing business processes and administrative workflows.

- Convert the business owner's voice notes and instructions into clear, structured procedures.

- Create and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), checklists and workflow guides and screen recording videos.

- Develop process flowcharts and step-by-step instructions where appropriate.

- Assist with building a comprehensive business operations manual.

- Review existing administrative processes and identify opportunities to improve efficiency.

- Help standardise procedures across job management, accounts, reporting and administration.

- Maintain organised digital records and documentation.

- Assist with implementing simple workflow improvements and automation where appropriate.

- Ensure processes are clearly documented to support staff training, consistency and future business growth.



5.
 Marketing & Customer Database Management

- Assist with preparing, updating and scheduling
 marketing campaigns through Mailchimp.

- Maintain accurate customer records and equipment information for targeted campaigns.

- Segment customer mailing lists according to their heating and cooling equipment, including ducted gas heaters, split systems and other installations.

- Assist with preparing seasonal cooling and heating service reminder campaigns.

- Manage the preparation of regular customer engagement
s, ideally once or twice per month.

- Use existing
 templates and update content, images and customer information as required.

- Review marketing
s for accuracy before scheduling or sending.

- Maintain mailing lists and ensure customer information is correctly recorded.

- Assist with basic
 marketing reporting and campaign tracking.

- Support other marketing administration tasks as required.



6. General Back-Office Administration & Compliance Support

- Provide general administrative support to the business owner and on-site office team.

- Maintain organised electronic records, spreadsheets and business documentation.

- Prepare reports, summaries and other administrative documents.

- Track outstanding administrative tasks and coordinate follow-ups with the relevant team members.

- Create and maintain reminders for company vehicle servicing.

- Track staff licensing, training requirements and renewal dates.

- Maintain relevant registers, records and compliance reminders.

- Assist with supplier and business information updates.

- Support accurate recordkeeping across the business's administrative systems.

- Help ensure routine administrative tasks are completed during busy operational periods.



7. Commercial Tendering & Project Administration (As Required)

- Organise supplier information, pricing documents and supporting records.

- Maintain tender documentation and submission checklists.

- Track important tender deadlines and outstanding requirements.

- Assist with basic project administration and document preparation.

- Provide administrative support to the business owner and Service Manager during the tendering process.



Commercial tendering is a potential future responsibility rather than a primary requirement at commencement.



​Skills and Qualifications



Essential Requirements



- Degree in Business Administration, Accounting, Finance or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

- Proven experience in administration, bookkeeping or operations support, preferably within an Australian trade or service business.

- Strong working knowledge of Xero, particularly bank reconciliations, supplier invoices, accounts payable, accounts receivable and financial reporting.

- Experience preparing operational reports and maintaining accurate business records.

- Strong attention to detail, particularly when reviewing financial information and job management data.

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple responsibilities independently.

- Proactive approach to identifying errors, following up on incomplete tasks and maintaining accurate records.



Highly Regarded

- Experience with Australian bookkeeping and payroll processes.

- Experience generating operational reports, technician productivity reports or KPI scoreboards.

- Experience using Mailchimp, including
 templates, customer segmentation and scheduled campaigns.

- Experience documenting business processes and preparing SOPs.

- Experience developing spreadsheets, reporting templates and workflow checklists.

- Exposure to commercial tendering, quotations or project administration.

- Familiarity with customer asset registers, equipment records and maintenance reminders.

- Knowledge of AI tools and workflow automation.

- Experience supporting a small business owner across multiple operational and administrative functions.



Personal Qualities:



We're looking for someone who is:

- An all-rounder – Comfortable handling a variety of administrative, operational and accounts-related tasks.

- Detail-oriented – Able to identify errors, discrepancies and missing information before they become bigger issues.

- Proactive – Takes initiative, follows up on outstanding tasks and does not require constant reminders.

- Organised – Able to manage competing priorities, deadlines and recurring administrative responsibilities.

- Analytical – Comfortable working with spreadsheets, reports and performance data.

- Reliable and accountable – Takes ownership of tasks and follows through until completion.

- Adaptable – Comfortable working in a growing business where priorities and responsibilities may change.

- A strong communicator – Able to communicate clearly with the business owner, office team and other stakeholders.



Tools Experience: 



Experience with the following would be an advantage:

- Ascora or any similar software or tools

- Xero

- Microsoft 365

- Mailchimp

- CRM Systems

-
 Marketing Platforms

- Process Documentation Tools

- AI & Automation Tools – ChatGPT, Zapier, Power Automate or similar



Key Success Factors: 



- Accurate Job Records – Ensure job, technician and equipment information is correctly recorded in the system. .

- Reliable Accounts Administration – Keep Xero reconciliations, invoices, payables and receivables accurate and up to date.

- Consistent Reporting – Prepare reliable weekly and monthly reports, KPI scoreboards and technician performance summaries.

I need an editor who can turn raw footage into tight, engaging videos of about 15-20 minutes. The goal is to publish about 2 videos a week once we’re running. This is an ongoing role, and I’m looking for someone dependable who can take raw material and find the story in it.



What You’ll Do



Review raw bodycam footage and reports, and find the strongest moments

Edit videos of about 15-20 minutes with a strong opening hook, good pacing, and clear structure

Handle redacted, blurred, and muted sections smoothly, using on-screen text, timelines, and graphics to carry the story

Add captions, simple graphics, sound cleanup, and music where it fits

Keep sensitive material handled responsibly (no medical records on screen, blur private names, factual language only)

Deliver a short clip log with each cut: file, timestamp, what happens, and any flags



Requirements



A portfolio showing documentary, true-crime, or commentary-style edits

Good judgment about what makes a gripping opening

Reliable turnaround and clear communication

Comfortable working with sensitive or distressing footage

Willing to keep all footage confidential



Nice to Have



Experience with bodycam or true-crime channels

Experience with Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or Final Cut

Thumbnail design skills



Paid Test

Shortlisted applicants get a paid test of $5: you’ll receive the full footage package and the detectives’ reports for one real case, and your task is to find the strongest moment and cut a 60-90 second hook within 3 days. Please include 2 sentences explaining why you chose that moment. The footage is confidential and isn’t to be published or used in your public portfolio, and you’ll be asked to delete it afterward.



Pay

Per-video rate to be agreed based on your experience and speed. Please state your rate in your application.



How to Apply

Please include:



A link to your portfolio (3 samples or more, preferably documentary or true-crime style)

Your rate per finished 15-20 minute video

Your usual turnaround for one video

Your availability (hours per week)

title: Social Media Assistant
description:
We’re a London-based creative and social media studio working with premium fashion, beauty, wellness and lifestyle brands, alongside younger consumer and Gen Z-focused businesses.



We’re looking for a Social Media Assistant to help us manage the day-to-day presence of multiple client accounts.



The biggest part of this role will be community engagement and publishing - keeping accounts active, visible and socially relevant through thoughtful comments, Story interaction, posting and day-to-day account management.



You’ll be working across brands with very different personalities, so being able to recognise and adapt to different tones of voice is essential. A comment that works for a playful Gen Z brand will not work for a premium skincare or luxury fashion client.



We’re looking for someone who genuinely understands social media culture rather than someone who simply knows how to schedule posts.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING 



* Manage day-to-day community engagement across Instagram and other relevant platforms

* Proactively engage with relevant accounts, creators, customers and communities through thoughtful, brand-appropriate comments

* Maintain visibility through Instagram Stories, including viewing, reacting and engaging where relevant

* Monitor comments, tags, mentions and DMs, responding where appropriate and flagging anything that needs attention from the wider team

* Schedule and publish approved content across multiple client accounts

* Keep content calendars accurate and ensure everything is posted correctly and on time

* Write and adapt short-form social copy across Instagram, TikTok and LinkedIn within established brand tones

* Stay socially aware of trends, conversations, memes, platform language and shifts in online culture

* Flag relevant trends and opportunities without forcing them onto brands where they don’t belong

* Create simple Instagram Story assets and social graphics using existing Canva templates

* Make simple edits to short-form video content, including trimming, subtitles and formatting

* Support monthly reporting and flag noticeable changes in account performance

* Keep client assets, calendars and internal documentation organised



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



* 1+ year of experience in social media, community management or a similar role

* Very strong understanding of Instagram and TikTok culture

* Strong written English

* Confidence adapting your writing and commenting style between completely different brands

* Good judgment around tone - knowing when a funny or casual comment works and when a brand should stay more considered and refined

* Comfortable proactively commenting and interacting rather than waiting for engagement to come to the account

* Basic Canva skills

* Basic short-form video editing skills

* Strong attention to detail - especially when switching between different client accounts

* Highly organised and comfortable following established processes





YOU'LL PROBABLY BE A GOOD FIT IF... 



- You notice when a brand’s comment section feels forced.

- You understand that “social media engagement” doesn’t mean leaving generic comments like Love this! under 50 posts.

- You know the difference between how a Gen Z wellness brand might speak online and how a premium fashion or skincare brand should behave.

- You follow trends, creators and online conversations naturally, but you also know that not every trend belongs on every account.

- And you’re comfortable learning the personality of each brand well enough that your engagement feels like it genuinely came from them.





WORKING SETUP



This is a remote role with a flexible schedule, but we require daily overlap between 10AM-3PM GMT for team communication, approvals and collaboration. You’ll work closely with our small team and follow established strategies, brand guidelines and engagement directions for each client.





HOW TO APPLY



Please send:

* A short cover letter explaining why you think you’d be a good fit

* Your CV

* A portfolio or examples of social media accounts/content you’ve worked on

* Links to any Instagram or TikTok accounts you have previously managed or supported

title: Front Desk & Hospitality Agent (Remote) — Philippines
description:
Front Desk & Hospitality Agent (Remote) — Philippines

Job post ready to paste (OnlineJobs.ph or similar) — hiring TWO agents from this one post



Title: Remote Front Desk & Hospitality Agent for a US River Resort — Reservations, Check-In/Out & Guest Care (2 Positions, Full-Time)

Category: Customer Service / Hospitality — Hotel Front Desk

Hours: Full-time, 40 hours/week, 5 days/week on a rotating schedule that includes weekends (our busiest days). Two shifts — tell us which fits your life:

Shift A (Day): Arizona 7:00 AM – 3:00 PM = Manila 10:00 PM – 6:00 AM (night shift — pay reflects it)

Shift B (Swing): Arizona 2:00 PM – 10:00 PM = Manila 5:00 AM – 1:00 PM (early shift, home by afternoon)

Pay: $850–$1,100 USD/month to start, based on experience and shift, paid reliably and on time — plus a separate on-call stipend (below). Performance review and raise discussion at 90 days.

Type: Long-term. You are joining a small Philippines team of four that helps run this resort — see below.



About us

We own a well-known riverfront resort and floating dock bar in Parker, Arizona, USA — a local landmark since 1967 on the Colorado River: 20 vacation bungalows, a restaurant and bar, a pool, and large events including weddings.

Twenty rooms means this is a hospitality job, not a call center. You will know our regulars by name, learn every bungalow, and talk with the same guests across their whole stay. We previously managed a remote team of 20 in the Philippines for years in another business. We pay on time, communicate directly, and treat our remote team as real staff — because you are.

The team you are joining

We are building a four-person Philippines team, and this post hires two of the four:

Back-Office Lead & Bookkeeper (hiring now, separately)

Front Desk Agent — Shift A (this post)

Front Desk Agent — Shift B (this post)

Social Media Editor (hiring now, separately)

The four of you will know each other, meet together on a weekly video call with the owner, share one handover log, and be cross-trained to relieve each other for days off and emergencies. We are hiring a team, not four strangers.

The job — you are the front desk of the resort

From your home office, you run everything a hotel front desk does except physically standing there:

Reservations

Answer booking inquiries by phone (VoIP),
, chat, and messaging — fast, warm, and accurate

Work inside our reservation system (PMS): create and modify bookings, manage the direct-booking website, and keep Airbnb / Vrbo / Expedia listings in sync

Send quotes, payment links, and confirmations; handle waitlists and cancellations strictly per policy

Check-in / check-out

Run our remote check-in: verify ID and payment in the system per checklist, send smart-lock codes and arrival instructions, and be the voice that welcomes the guest

Manage departures: checkout messages, damage/i
 notes, and instantly dispatching the clean to housekeeping

Prepare tomorrow's arrivals and departures list every shift

Guest care during the stay

First point of contact for guests: questions, extra towels, Wi-Fi help, restaurant hours, river and town recommendations

Coordinate housekeeping (clean status, turn priorities) and maintenance (create and chase tickets in our task system until closed) so a guest never has to ask twice

Offer the right extras at the right moment — late checkout, early check-in, event tickets — helpful, never pushy

Handover & on-call (how we cover 24/7)

Staffed hours are 7 AM–10 PM Arizona. The two shifts overlap 2–3 PM for a live handover, and every shift ends with notes in the shared log — the next person never starts blind

Overnight (10 PM–7 AM Arizona) is on-call, not a staffed shift. Late check-ins are mostly self-serve (lock codes sent automatically). The on-call teammate keeps the phone, and responds within ~15 minutes only to real needs: a lockout, a late-arrival problem, an urgent issue. Overnight Arizona is 1 PM–10 PM in Manila — you are awake, at home, living your afternoon; you are simply reachable. On-call rotates weekly across all four teammates, pays a separate stipend, and genuine emergencies escalate by phone to our on-site manager — you are never the last resort for a true emergency

What a shift actually looks like (you will not be bored)

Twenty rooms means some hours are quiet — and some hours everyone arrives at once. Your shift runs in three modes: live coverage first (guest messages and phones interrupt everything, always), scheduled work every shift, and a project board you pull from when the inbox is quiet. Nobody here watches a clock; there's always a next useful thing, and most of it visibly makes the resort better.

Shift A (Day) — Checkouts and dispatching housekeeping turns until every room is rolling; every inbox (PMS, Airbnb, Vrbo, Expedia,
) cleared to zero; today's arrivals prepped with lock codes verified; a daily rate/listing check so our prices and availability match on every site; every new guest review answered or drafted the same day; then the project board.

Shift B (Swing) — Check-ins and welcome messages; in-house guests looked after end-to-end (a request isn't done until the guest confirms it is); tomorrow's arrivals, housekeeping schedule, and maintenance flags staged tonight, not discovered tomorrow; the follow-up block — every unanswered booking inquiry gets its 2nd and 3rd follow-up, because that's where bookings are actually won; event-inquiry intake; then the project board.

The project board (your quiet-hour work, in rotation): past-guest rebooking campaigns from our guest database, reviving old unconverted inquiries, listing and photo audits, keeping guest profiles clean and tagged, chasing any maintenance ticket older than 48 hours, weekend readiness checks, and writing the how-to guides that make the whole team faster. Good agents like this board — it's where you stop being an inbox and start being the person who makes the resort run.

Your authority — and its limits

You may: take bookings, send payment links through the reservation system, apply the written rate/cancellation/late-checkout policies, dispatch housekeeping and maintenance, and solve ordinary guest problems on the spot.

You will never: take a card number by phone or chat (system payment links only), offer discounts or refunds outside policy without US management approval, or handle an emergency alone — safety issues go instantly to the on-site manager and, when needed, local emergency services per our protocol. Clear limits, so you always know exactly where you stand.

You must have

2+ years in hospitality customer-facing work — hotel/resort front desk, reservations, vacation rentals, or Airbnb/Vrbo co-hosting strongly preferred

Reservation-system (PMS) experience — any of: RMS, WebRezPro, Cloudbeds, Mews, Opera, RoomKey, or similar — and confidence learning a new one quickly

Excellent spoken English — guests will judge our resort by your phone voice. Warm, clear, unhurried, American-guest-friendly

Strong written English for guest messaging — friendly and professional, no scripts read like a robot

Calm under pressure: the angry guest, the double-booking scare, the lock that won't open — you breathe, follow the checklist, escalate at the right moment

Night/early-shift reliability matching the shift you choose, on a rotating schedule including weekends, with a home setup to match: high-speed internet, your own computer, headset, and a real backup plan (power + internet) for brownouts

Big plus if you have

Experience with Breezeway or another housekeeping/maintenance task system

Experience with smart locks and remote/self check-in for vacation rentals

OTA extranet experience (
 / Expedia Partner Central / Airbnb host tools)

You have worked with US guests before and genuinely like hospitality — it shows on the phone

How to apply — please follow exactly

Start your application with the word DOCK so we know you read this. Then answer briefly:

Which shift (A or B) fits your life, and why does it work for you long-term?

Describe your front-desk/reservations experience: property size, the PMS you used, and the channels you handled.

Scenario (written): A guest messages at 9:40 PM: "We're outside Bungalow 12, the lock code doesn't work, it's hot, and my kids are tired. This is ridiculous." Write the exact first message you send them, and list what you do in the next 15 minutes.

Scenario (judgment): A caller says the website price is too high and asks you to "just take $50 off if I book right now." What do you say, and what do you do?

What are your internet speed, computer, headset, and backup power/internet plan?

Applications without the word DOCK and without real answers to #3 and #4 will not be reviewed.

Hiring process

Shortlisted applicants get a paid test ($30 USD): a mock guest-inbox triage (real-style messages to prioritize and answer) and a 10-minute mock check-in call on Zoom — we are hiring a voice as much as a typist

Top candidates do a paid 1-week trial at the agreed rate, shadowing live shifts alongside the other agent

. Send template follow-up

title: BDR, Lead Generation and CRM Operations
description:
BDR (Business Development Representative), Lead Generation and CRM Operations

ABOUT US

We're an AI and SEO startup helping companies get found, not just on Google but on AI driven platforms like ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Google's AI Overviews. This emerging field is called GEO (Generative Engine Optimization), and it's where search is heading. We work with growth minded businesses that want to stay visible as discovery shifts from blue links to AI answers. Founded by a serial entrepreneur who has built and scaled multiple ventures, the company is small, fast, and built for the new era of AI enabled search.



ABOUT THE ROLE

You'll own lead generation and CRM operations for one of our core clients, a B2B data and analytics company that sells to insurance carriers, managing general agents (MGAs), reinsurers, and brokers. Their sales motion runs on industry conferences, targeted
 campaigns, and LinkedIn outreach.



This role exists because the prospecting and data work behind those campaigns is detailed, recurring, and important to get right. Before each conference, we narrow attendee lists to qualified targets, enrich contacts, and prepare outreach. After each event, we handle follow-up and cleanup. In between, we run broader
 campaigns and keep the CRM clean. You'll take that work off our plate and run it reliably using our SOPs and AI tools.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



1. Prospect list building and qualification

- Build prospect lists from conference attendee rosters, industry directories, and Apollo

- Use Claude or similar AI tools to research, classify, and filter companies and contacts in bulk against our ideal customer profile

- Verify AI output and flag anything that looks off



2. Contact enrichment

- Enrich contacts in Apollo and match them to existing CRM records

- Fill gaps using manual research when Apollo coverage is thin



3. CRM operations in Pipedrive

- Deduplicate records, apply labels, and update marketing consent status

- Build filters for campaign sends following our naming conventions

- Cross-check prospect lists against current customers and suppression lists before any send



4. Campaign and outreach support

- Prepare
 campaigns for review (every send goes through a strict approval process, and you'll follow it every time)

- Identify LinkedIn targets and organize connection lists



5. Website QA and reporting

- Check for broken links and confirm tracking is in place before major sends

- Pull simple reports on list sizes, campaign results, and outreach status



6. SOPs

- Follow our documented processes in Notion

- Update SOPs as you learn, so the process gets better every cycle



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

- Proven experience in B2B lead generation and list building

- Hands-on experience with Apollo (search, enrichment, bulk matching)

- Experience using Claude, ChatGPT, or similar tools to filter and qualify leads at scale, with good judgment about checking the output

- CRM experience, ideally Pipedrive (HubSpot or Salesforce also welcome)

- Strong spreadsheet skills (filtering, lookups, deduplication)

- Extremely detail-oriented. A single wrong filter can send an
 to the wrong list, so accuracy matters more than speed.

- Comfortable following SOPs and asking questions rather than guessing

- Clear written English and reliable communication

- Able to overlap at least a few hours per day with U.S. Pacific time

- Open to working differently. We're an AI-first team and build our workflows around tools like Claude, Claude Code, Claude Cowork, and Notion. This one is non-negotiable.



NICE TO HAVE

- Experience in insurance or another niche B2B vertical

- LinkedIn Sales Navigator experience

- Familiarity with
 marketing consent rules

- Interest in building AI automations and better workflows



WHY JOIN

You'll work directly with the founder, not through layers of management. You'll own a real piece of the client's growth engine and see the results of your work. The role starts at 15 to 20 hours per week, and there's room to grow into more hours and responsibility for the right person. We move fast, use AI in everything we do, and are always testing new tools, so you'll learn a lot. Our core values are simple: be kind, be generous, and always be learning.



HOW TO APPLY

Please send:

1. A 1-minute screen recording (Loom or similar) showing how you'd use Claude or another AI tool to filter a list of 200 conference attendees down to qualified prospects, and roughly how long it would take you

2. A short note on which tools you'd recommend for enriching contacts at small regional insurance companies, where Apollo data is often thin, and why

3. Your experience with Apollo and any CRM you've used

4. Your hourly rate within our range, the hours you're typically available (in Pacific time), and whether you'd be interested in more hours over time

5. A screenshot of your Kolbe A result, if you have one

title: Sales Development Representative (Appointment Setter) - Remote

MUST SUBMIT RESUME AND VOICE RECORDING TO BE CONSIDERED FOR THIS ROLE

The Role

We're hiring B2B sales screeners to set demo appointments for an AI autoresponder system built for home service contractors. This is a fully remote role with a company based in California. You'll work B2B leads from our internal database, generate interest with business owners, and book qualified demo appointments for our closing team.



Compensation

Hourly base plus commission on every demo booked and every demo that converts to a sale. Commission is uncapped and paid on a fast cycle.



What You're Selling

A fully customizable AI autoresponder that replies to a contractor's leads within seconds, qualifies the customer, and moves them toward a booked call. This is a B2B product sold directly to home service business owners across the country, including plumbers, HVAC technicians, electricians, painters, roofers, fencing companies, and plasterers.



These owners are highly skilled at their craft, but most have not been trained in sales or marketing. They miss leads, respond hours late, and lose jobs to whichever competitor gets back to the customer first. They have already paid for the lead, they simply cannot reach it fast enough. Our product solves that problem, and once a contractor sees how it works, the value is immediately clear.

- Work B2B leads from our internal database through phone, text, and

This position is focused on the front end of the B2B sales process. Screeners do not run demos, quote pricing, or close deals. Those responsibilities sit with the closing team. Your performance is measured by the volume and quality of demos you set.



Schedule and Structure

This is a full-time, fully remote role. Candidates must be available to work 9 AM to 5 PM PST, Monday through Friday, aligned with California hours. The week is structured around consistent phone, text, and
 outreach. A reliable internet connection, a quiet work environment, and a professional phone setup are required.



What We Provide

- A targeted internal lead database of B2B prospects, so you are not building a cold list from scratch

- Scripts, objection-handling frameworks, and recorded calls to support your ramp

- A defined booking process and the tools needed to manage your pipeline

- Hourly base pay during ramp, plus uncapped commission tied to your output

- A collaborative remote team environment built around clear sales fundamentals



Who We're Looking For

- Fluent English, both spoken and written

- Clear, easily understood spoken English on calls with US business owners (your voice recording is reviewed for this first)

- Available to work 9 AM to 5 PM PST, Monday through Friday

- One or more years of B2B phone-based sales, appointment setting, SDR, or BDR experience

- Strong phone presence and clear, professional written communication

- Comfortable with high-volume outreach and real-time objection handling

- Self-directed, organized, and able to manage your own pipeline without daily supervision

- Reliable, punctual, and consistent in performance

- Proven ability to work effectively in a remote environment

- No prior experience with our product, platform, or industry is required, full training is provided

- Preferred: B2B experience selling to contractors, trades, or local small businesses

- Preferred: genuine interest in AI and emerging sales technology



About Us

We are a California based company that works closely with home service contractors and specializes in performance from top to bottom. We partner with B2B clients that already have strong reputations, high star ratings, and solid response times, and help them reach the top of their market through optimization, lead handling improvements, and a custom AI autoresponder built for their business. Our clients respond faster than anyone else in their service area and stop losing jobs to slow follow-up.

This is a B2B screening role, not a closing role. It is the front of our sales funnel and a critical part of our team. For candidates who perform well, there is a clear path toward closing and other senior sales positions. If you are motivated, disciplined on the phone, and interested in building a career in AI-driven B2B sales, we encourage you to apply.

Chiropractic Coding Specialist



Full Circle Billing Solutions



Position Summary



The Chiropractic Coding Specialist is responsible for accurately reviewing, coding, and preparing chiropractic services for insurance claim submission. This position ensures that CPT, ICD-10-CM, modifiers, units, and other claim information are supported by provider documentation and meet payer-specific billing requirements.



The ideal candidate has strong knowledge of chiropractic coding, insurance guidelines, medical necessity, claim edits, and documentation requirements. Accuracy and attention to detail are essential to reducing denials and ensuring clean claim submission.



Qualifications

Knowledge of chiropractic medical billing and coding.

Working knowledge of CPT, HCPCS, and ICD-10-CM coding.

Understanding of chiropractic manipulation and therapy coding.

Strong attention to detail.

Ability to read and interpret chiropractic clinical documentation.

Knowledge of insurance claim requirements and medical necessity.

Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Ability to meet productivity and accuracy expectations.

Coding accuracy

Turnaround time

Coding-related denial rate

Accuracy of modifiers and units

Documentation compliance

Timely correction of coding errors

Communication and follow-up with billing staff/providers

Work Standards



The Chiropractic Coding Specialist is expected to demonstrate professionalism, confidentiality, accuracy, dependability, and strong time-management skills. title: Fast VSL Video Editor (Direct Response), Paid Test Project, Long-Term Work
description:
We sell a faith-based audio program to American women ages 45 to 70, using long sales videos (VSLs) on
. We test new versions every week, so speed is the most important skill for this job. The faster you deliver, the faster we learn what works, and the more work you get.



We’re not looking for someone who just cuts clips. We want an editor who understands people: what makes a viewer feel something, what makes her lean in, and what makes her stay to the very end. Your job is to take our script and bring it to life.



How it works

The owner’s AI voice is already built in HeyGen. You don’t need to create a voice. You’ll get:



Login access to the HeyGen account, where you make the voiceover from our script using the owner’s voice.

The script (the copy) and a detailed cut sheet that says what is spoken, what she sees on screen, and what text appears.

A folder with all the assets: footage, photos, testimonial clips, app screens and music. If you need anything that isn’t there, tell us right away.

Examples of our past sales videos, so you can see the style we want.



You make the voiceover, then build the video. Do it to the best of your ability, as fast as you can.



What you’ll do



Make the voiceover in HeyGen from our script. Get the pacing right: natural pauses, emphasis, and slower delivery on the emotional lines.

Edit 25 to 35 minute VSLs from the script and cut sheet.

Use timing, music, silence, and visuals to make the viewer feel each moment: tension, relief, hope.

Cut every 3 to 5 seconds. Show everything that’s said: if the speaker says “bill,” we see a bill.

Burn in captions: big, high contrast, every word. Most viewers watch with the sound off.

Add B-roll, simple motion graphics (text cards, stamps, counters, a price stack) and sound design.

Edit in real customer testimonial clips and cut them to exact words.

Turn around fast versions for testing, often several versions of the same video.



You must be



A great editor. Your work makes people stop scrolling and keep watching.

A student of human behavior. You understand why people watch, why they leave, and what makes them feel and act. You know when to cut fast and when to hold still and let a moment land.

Fast. A first draft of 5 minutes of finished video, voiceover included, within [24 to 48] hours. Faster is better.

Skilled in Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or CapCut Pro.

Strong in English reading. You’ll work from a written script and cut sheet.

Reliable, with good internet and [X] hours a day available, with some overlap with US Central Time.



Nice to have



Experience editing VSLs, sales videos, or direct-response ads.

Experience with HeyGen or other AI voice and video tools.

Experience with ads for US audiences over 45.

Can source good stock footage quickly.

Knows
 ad formats (9:16, 4:5, 1:1).



Pay



Paid test: $[40 to 60] for the voiceover and edit of the first 5 minutes of our VSL. Paid whether or not we hire you.

Full-time or part-time: $[amount] per month, based on speed and quality. Bonuses for versions that beat our current winner.



The paid test (this is how we choose)

After a short screening, you’ll get:



HeyGen access with the owner’s voice.

The first 5 minutes of the script and cut sheet.

The assets folder.

Examples of our past sales videos.
