title: Social Media Strategist & Organic Growth Specialist
description:
Social Media Strategist & Organic Growth Specialist (Part-Time)



Company: HeartWired Marketing

Location: Remote, Philippines

Job Type: Part-Time | Long-Term Opportunity

Compensation: Based on experience and demonstrated results

Schedule: Flexible part-time hours with some overlap with U.S. Eastern Time



IMPORTANT: Applications are accepted ONLY through OnlineJobs.ph. Please do not contact us through
, phone, text, WhatsApp, or social media. Direct inquiries outside this platform will not be considered.



About HeartWired Marketing



HeartWired Marketing is a U.S.-based digital marketing agency helping small and medium-sized businesses build stronger brands, connect with their audiences, and grow through strategic digital marketing.



We work with businesses across multiple industries, including professional services, hospitality, health and wellness, retail, and local service businesses.



We're looking for a creative, experienced, and results-driven Social Media Strategist & Organic Growth Specialist to join our growing team on a part-time basis.



We're not looking for someone who simply creates Canva graphics, writes captions, and schedules posts.



We need someone who understands how social media works beyond the content itself. Someone who knows how to grow accounts organically, increase meaningful engagement, develop effective content strategies, and help turn followers into potential customers.



You should be comfortable both developing the strategy and executing it.



Key Responsibilities



Social Media Strategy & Growth



- Develop and implement organic social media strategies for multiple client accounts.

- Create actionable plans to increase reach, followers, engagement, and brand awareness.

- Research target audiences, competitors, trends, and industry-specific opportunities.

- Identify ways to grow relevant audiences without relying solely on paid advertising.

- Optimize social profiles, content formats, captions, and posting strategies.

- Develop creative ways to increase visibility, encourage conversations, and build online communities.

- Stay current with platform algorithms, trends, and best practices.

- Proactively suggest ideas and opportunities for improvement.



Content Creation & Management



- Create engaging, original, and brand-appropriate content for
, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, and other relevant platforms.

- Design professional graphics, carousels, and other visual content.

- Create and edit short-form videos, Reels, and similar content.

- Write compelling captions that encourage engagement and action.

- Develop and manage organized social media content calendars.

- Schedule and publish content consistently across multiple client accounts.

- Adapt content to different platforms, audiences, industries, and brand personalities.

- Repurpose existing content strategically without simply reposting identical material everywhere.

- Use AI tools to support creativity and efficiency while ensuring content remains authentic and original.



Audience Engagement & Community Growth



- Develop strategies that encourage meaningful conversations and interactions.

- Monitor comments and identify opportunities for engagement.

- Recommend approaches to community building and relationship development.

- Identify collaboration opportunities and relevant audience communities.

- Help clients connect with potential customers through organic engagement.



Analytics & Performance Improvement



- Track social media performance, including reach, engagement, follower growth, website traffic, and other relevant metrics.

- Analyze content performance to understand what's working and what isn't.

- Provide clear, easy-to-understand performance reports.

- Recommend adjustments based on actual data.

- Test different content types, messaging, and approaches to improve results.

- Focus on meaningful growth that supports client business objectives, not vanity metrics alone.



Required Qualifications



- At least 3 years of professional social media marketing experience.

- Proven experience growing social media accounts organically.

- Strong understanding of
, Instagram, LinkedIn, and TikTok.

- Experience developing and implementing social media strategies.

- Excellent written English with the ability to create natural, conversational content for U.S. audiences.

- Strong graphic design skills using Canva or similar platforms.

- Experience with short-form video creation and editing using CapCut or similar software.

- Experience managing multiple social media accounts.

- Understanding of audience development, content optimization, social media SEO, and engagement strategies.

- Ability to interpret performance metrics and recommend improvements.

- Strong organizational and time-management skills.

- Ability to work independently, meet deadlines, and communicate effectively.

- A proactive mindset and willingness to bring new ideas to the table.



Preferred Qualifications



- Previous experience working with a U.S.-based marketing agency.

- Experience managing social media for local small businesses.

- Familiarity with social media scheduling and reporting platforms.

- Experience developing LinkedIn thought leadership content.

- Understanding of social media lead generation and conversion strategies.

- Basic knowledge of paid social media advertising.

- Experience working across several industries and adapting to different brand voices.



What We're Looking For



We value someone who thinks strategically, takes ownership of their work, and isn't afraid to recommend a better approach.



We want someone who:



- Understands the difference between posting content and building an audience.

- Can explain WHY a particular strategy should work.

- Knows how to create content that people actually want to engage with.

- Understands how organic social media contributes to business growth.

- Takes initiative instead of waiting for step-by-step instructions.

- Can manage multiple clients without producing generic, cookie-cutter content.

- Uses analytics to make informed decisions.

- Communicates clearly and consistently.

- Is interested in a long-term working relationship.



We're not expecting every post to go viral. We want thoughtful strategies, consistent improvement, and measurable progress.



Position Details



This is a part-time, remote position with the opportunity to grow as our agency and client base expand.



You'll work with our team to support social media strategy, content creation, audience development, and performance improvement across multiple client accounts.



The schedule is flexible, although some availability during U.S. Eastern Time business hours is preferred for collaboration and communication.



We're looking for someone who can become a dependable, long-term member of our team.



How to Apply



Applications must be submitted exclusively through this OnlineJobs.ph job posting.



Please include the following information in your application:



1. Portfolio: Share examples of social media accounts you've managed and content you've personally created.



2. Proven Growth Results: Provide at least two examples of accounts you've successfully grown organically. Include starting metrics, ending metrics, the timeframe, and the strategies you used.



3. Your Strategy: Briefly explain what you would do during your first 30 days managing a small business Instagram account that has been posting consistently but experiencing little engagement or follower growth.



4. Your Tools: List the content creation, video editing, scheduling, and analytics platforms you use.



5. Your Experience: Tell us about your experience managing multiple clients or working with a marketing agency.



6. Your Availability: Include your expected monthly compensation in USD, the number of hours you're available per week, and your typical working schedule.



To confirm you've read the entire job posting, begin your application with the words "Growth Through Strategy."



Important Application Instructions



We will ONLY review applications submitted directly through OnlineJobs.ph.



DO NOT contact HeartWired Marketing or its team members through
, phone calls, text messages, WhatsApp,
, Instagram, LinkedIn, or any other outside communication channel.



Applications and inquiries received outside OnlineJobs.ph will not be considered.



Qualified candidates will be contacted through OnlineJobs.ph regarding next steps.



Why Join HeartWired Marketing?



We're a growing marketing agency that believes effective marketing is about more than simply being visible. It's about building connections, earning trust, and creating opportunities for businesses to grow.



You'll have the opportunity to work with different industries, contribute creative ideas, develop strategies, and see the impact of your work.



We're looking for someone who wants to grow with our agency and become a valued part of our team.



If you know how to combine great content with genuine audience growth, we want to hear from you.

title: Social Media Video Editor & Content Manager — Remote, Philippines
description:
Title: Social Media Video Editor & Content Manager for a Famous Arizona River Resort — Full-Time, Long-Term (Reels/TikTok)

Category: Marketing / Social Media — Video Editing

Hours: Full-time, 40 hours/week

Shift: Manila time, 6:00 AM – 2:00 PM, 5 days/week — a normal Manila daytime shift (no graveyard). It lines up with 3:00–11:00 PM Arizona time, our peak social and event hours, so you can post and respond while the resort is alive.

Pay: $900–$1,200 USD/month, based on experience, paid reliably and on time — plus a share of the team's rotating on-call stipend (explained below). Performance review and raise discussion at 90 days.

Type: Long-term, as one of a four-person Philippines team that helps run this resort.



About us

We own a well-known riverfront resort and floating dock bar in Parker, Arizona, USA — a local landmark since 1967, on the Colorado River. We have about 33,000 Instagram followers, 20 vacation bungalows, a restaurant and bar, a pool, live music, DJs, and big weekend events.

Our on-site team shoots a lot of raw phone video and photos every week — sunsets, drinks being made, boats, live events, the pool, our bungalows — and our staff run a monthly content contest that keeps the raw footage flowing. What we need is you: the person who turns that raw material into polished posts, every week, without fail, and keeps our social channels feeling alive and human.

The team you are joining

We are building a four-person Philippines team: a Back-Office Lead & Bookkeeper, two Front Desk & Hospitality Agents, and you, the Social Media Editor. The four of you will know each other, meet weekly on video with the owner, share one team chat and handover log, and be cross-trained to relieve each other. Your part of the cross-coverage: roughly one shift-block per week of front-desk message triage (answering routine guest messages from templates — no payments, no phones until you're trained and cleared), plus a rotating share of the team's overnight on-call week (Arizona overnight is Manila afternoon/evening — you're reachable at home, not at a desk). In return, when you take leave, the team covers your queue the same way. Nobody here is a lone contractor; you are staff.

The job

You will:

Edit short-form video from raw phone clips our staff uploads to a shared folder — Reels / TikTok /
, vertical, with clean cuts, captions/subtitles, strong first-2-seconds hooks, cover frames, and music from the platforms' licensed libraries

Write captions in natural, fun American English (AI tools are welcome — we use them too — but the final caption must sound like a person at a river bar, not a bot)

Schedule and publish — 4–5 feed posts per week plus daily Stories, across Instagram,
, and TikTok, using Meta Business Suite and a scheduling tool. Posting happens in Arizona evening hours — your shift is built for it

Run community replies during your shift — routine comments and DMs from an approved guide (hours, location, menus, event info, booking questions routed to the front-desk team) — and escalate anything sensitive (complaints, i
, legal, press) to the owner the same day. Never improvise on sensitive replies

Track the staff content contest — log who submitted clips, which ones we published, and the monthly leaderboard (we give you the format) — this contest is your footage supply chain, treat it like one

Keep the content library organized — every raw clip and finished edit filed and tagged in the resort's own library, so the resort's content is an asset that lives with the resort

Send one short report per week — what you published, best/worst performers (saves and shares matter more to us than likes), booking-link clicks where visible, and what raw footage you need more of next week

For the first 90 days, nothing posts without the owner's approval — you'll send a weekly batch for a quick approve/revise. Proven judgment earns real independence after that.

You must have

2+ years editing short-form social video for a business (not just personal accounts) — a portfolio of business Reels/TikToks you personally edited is required

Strong skills in CapCut and/or Premiere Pro, and Canva

Experience scheduling in Meta Business Suite (Later, Buffer, or Metricool is a plus)

Written English good enough to caption like a native speaker on a good day — voice matters more than grammar perfection, but both matter

Reliability on a fixed 6 AM–2 PM Manila schedule, a home setup with high-speed internet, your own computer, and a backup plan for brownouts

The discipline of a newsroom habit: content goes out on schedule even when the week is boring — especially when the week is boring

Big plus if you have

Hospitality, travel, restaurant, or nightlife brand experience

You understand American river/lake/boating culture — or you're genuinely curious enough to learn it fast (our audience can smell a fake in one caption)

Comment/DM community management experience

Basic photo editing and thumbnail/cover design beyond templates

How to apply — please follow exactly

Start your application with the word RIVER so we know you read this. Then:

Link 3 business Reels/TikToks you personally edited (say what was yours: edit, captions, both)

Scenario: A guest posts a public comment: "Waited 40 minutes for a burger and the staff could care less. Won't be back." Write the exact public reply you'd post, and note what you'd do privately

Tell us your tools (editing apps, scheduling tools) and your internet speed, computer, and backup plan

In two or three sentences: a river resort bar posts a gorgeous sunset with no people in it, and it flops. A shaky bartender video does 10× better. Why — and what does that change about what you'd ask our staff to film?

Applications without the word RIVER and without the 3 links will not be reviewed.

Hiring process

Shortlisted applicants get a paid test edit ($30 USD): we send raw staff clips from a real event night; you return 2 finished Reels with captions within 48 hours

Top candidate does a paid 2-week trial at the agreed rate — real content, real schedule, with the approval workflow in place

Then an ongoing monthly arrangement, reviewed at 90 days, cross-training into team coverage from month two

We are a digital marketing agency seeking a Creative Marketing Lead to own creative direction and asset production across our marketing efforts.



This role is for someone who has true creative ownership and strategic vision—someone who can define what a campaign or initiative should be and drive it to completion, rather than simply designing pieces under someone else’s plan. If your background is strictly producing graphics handed down to you by a manager, this won't be the right fit.  design and web/landing page visuals

title: Land Pricing Analyst
description:
Summary

We're a high-volume land flipping business looking for a sharp Land Pricing Analyst to join our team. 



You'll be analyzing and pricing vacant land properties (mostly rural/desert parcels) using comparable sales and our established criteria. 



The work is process-driven and steady — ideal for someone who enjoys focused analytical work.



You don't need a real estate background — if you're analytical, detail-oriented, and comfortable doing focused solo work, we'll teach you the rest.

What you'll do:



Analyze and price a high volume of vacant land properties

Select and evaluate comparable sales, adjusting for differences in size, access, utilities, terrain, and location

Cross-reference data from county records, GIS/parcel maps, and assessor sites

Follow a structured process for pricing and basic due diligence

Flag unusual or higher-risk properties for review rather than forcing a number

Keep clean, organized records of your work



Skills we're looking for:



Strong comp selection judgment — knowing which sales are truly comparable and which to discard

Sound adjustment reasoning — understanding that price per acre isn't linear and adjusting accordingly

Data fluency — fast and accurate with spreadsheets and pulling data from multiple sources

Consistency — applying the same logic the same way across high volume

Attention to detail — catching access issues, easements, flood zones, and landlocked parcels

Good judgment — knowing the limits of the analysis and when to escalate



Who you are:



Analytical and detail-oriented

Some technical or analytical background is a plus (data, finance, engineering, CS, or similar), but not required

Comfortable with focused, heads-down work for long stretches

Self-directed and reliable

Able to communicate clearly

Solid internet connection



This is high-volume work, so consistency and accuracy both matter. If you take pride in clean, careful analysis, you'll fit in well here.



Please submit a short voice sample why you would be a good fit for this job.

description:

Compensation:** Based on Experience + Performance Bonuses



 About Us



Mile High Standard Cleaning is a professional residential and commercial cleaning company serving the Denver, Colorado metro area.



We're seeking an experienced, proactive Virtual Assistant to help generate new business through outbound prospecting, past lead reactivation, appointment setting, and relationship development.



This is a results-driven position focused on generating qualified cleaning opportunities and helping grow our customer base.



 Key Responsibilities



**1. B2B Outreach & Business Development**



- Work through our existing database of property management companies, real estate professionals, and potential business partners.

- Conduct outbound outreach through phone calls, personalized
s, and other appropriate channels.

- Follow up with prospects who previously expressed interest but weren't ready to move forward.

- Research new property management companies, real estate businesses, and other potential referral partners throughout the Denver metro area.

**4. Appointment Setting & Pipeline Management**



- Qualify interested prospects based on their cleaning needs, location, and timeline.

- Schedule cleaning appointments or business development calls with qualified leads.

- Maintain accurate records of prospect interactions and follow-up activity.

- Update CRM records and lead statuses.

- Provide daily reports on outreach activity, responses, appointments, and opportunities generated.

- Excellent spoken and written English.

- Strong follow-up skills and ability to handle objections professionally.

- Experience using CRM software, Google Sheets, and lead tracking systems.

- Previous experience with lead reactivation campaigns.

- Familiarity with B2B prospecting and cold
 outreach.
